/** Integrated university Scope 1/2 application service.
 * Every exported write is called inside the shared tenant transaction and idempotency wrapper.
 * Period-scoped advisory locks serialize final allocation/overlap decisions across API instances.
 */
import { version,role } from '../../core.mjs';
import { fields,uuid,text,reason,choice,day,decimal,scaled,format,sum,evidenceIds,overlaps,csvParse,fail } from '../core.mjs';
import { authorOnly,independent } from '../collection.mjs';
import { SOURCE_KINDS,CHECKLIST,EXTRA_KPIS } from './catalog.mjs';
import * as rules from './core.mjs';
const WRITE=['ADMIN','ENTRY'],REVIEW=['ADMIN','REVIEWER'];
export async function lockPeriod(s,pid){await s.lockKey('scope12-governance');const p=await s.period(uuid(pid));await s.lockKey('scope12-period:'+p.id);return p;}
export async function activeBoundary(s,pid,{required=true}={}){const rows=await s.rows('u_c_boundaries',{period_id:uuid(pid),status:'APPROVED'},100);const r=rows.sort((a,b)=>b.revision-a.revision)[0];if(!r&&required)fail(409,'BOUNDARY_REQUIRED','Register sources, assess the campus boundary and independently approve the Scope 1/2 plan first.');return r||null;}
export async function liveRecords(s,pid){const records=await s.rows('u_c_records',{period_id:pid},5000),voids=await s.rows('u_c_voids',{period_id:pid,status:'APPROVED'},5000);const omitted=new Set(voids.map(v=>v.record_id));return records.filter(r=>!['CANCELLED','REJECTED'].includes(r.status)&&!omitted.has(r.id));}
export async function sourceAccess(s,source){if(s.user.role==='ENTRY'&&source.owner_id!==s.user.id)fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Source not found.');}
export function recordAccess(s,r){if(s.user.role==='ENTRY'&&r.created_by!==s.user.id)fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Record not found.');}
export async function createSource(s,b){role(s.user,['ADMIN']);const a=rules.sourceInput(b);await s.location(a.campus_id,a.department_id);await s.userRef(a.owner_id,['ADMIN','ENTRY']);
 if(a.building_id){const building=await s.get('buildings',a.building_id);if(building.campus_id!==a.campus_id)fail(422,'BUILDING_CAMPUS','Building does not belong to this campus.');}
 const r=await s.insert('u_c_sources',{...a,created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_SOURCE_REGISTERED',r.id,{code:r.code,kind:r.kind,scope:r.scope});return r;}
export async function installExtraKpis(s,b){role(s.user,['ADMIN']);fields(b,[]);await s.lockKey('scope12-kpi-install');let added=0;
 for(const t of EXTRA_KPIS){if(await s.count('u_kpis',{code:t.code}))continue;await s.insert('u_kpis',{code:t.code,name:t.name,domain:t.domain,unit:t.unit,aggregation:t.aggregation,evidence_required:true,max_value:null,guidance:t.guidance,created_by:s.user.id});added++;}
 await s.audit('C_EXTRA_KPIS_INSTALLED',null,{added});return {added,definitions:EXTRA_KPIS.length,measurementsSeeded:false,factorsSeeded:false};}
export async function createFactor(s,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);const r=await s.insert('u_c_factors',{...rules.factorInput(b),status:'DRAFT',approved_by:null,created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_FACTOR_DRAFTED',r.id,{version:r.version_label});return r;}
export async function editFactor(s,rid,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);const {version:expected,...input}=b,values=rules.factorInput(input),old=await s.get('u_c_factors',uuid(rid),{lock:true});version(old,expected);authorOnly(s.user,old);if(!['DRAFT','REJECTED'].includes(old.status))fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','An approved factor cannot change; create a new version.');const r=await s.update('u_c_factors',old.id,{...values,status:'DRAFT',rejection_reason:null});await s.audit('C_FACTOR_EDITED',r.id);return r;}
export async function reviewFactor(s,rid,action,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);fields(b,['version','reason']);const old=await s.get('u_c_factors',uuid(rid),{lock:true});version(old,b.version);independent(s.user,old);if(old.status!=='DRAFT')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only a draft factor can be reviewed.');choice(action,['approve','reject'],'action');
 const r=await s.update('u_c_factors',old.id,{status:action==='approve'?'APPROVED':'REJECTED',approved_by:action==='approve'?s.user.id:null,rejection_reason:action==='reject'?reason(b.reason):null});await s.audit('C_FACTOR_'+r.status,r.id,{source:r.source,version:r.version_label});return r;}
async function validateBoundary(s,a,p){
 const campuses=await s.rows('campuses',{},200),declared=new Set([...a.campus_ids,...a.campus_exclusions.map(c=>c.campusId)]);
 if(campuses.some(c=>!declared.has(c.id))||declared.size!==campuses.length)fail(422,'CAMPUS_COVERAGE','Include or explicitly exclude every registered campus.');
 const src=await s.rows('u_c_sources',{campus_id:a.campus_ids},1000),active=src.filter(x=>x.active_from<=p.end_date&&x.active_to>=p.start_date),ids=new Set(a.sources.map(x=>x.sourceId));
 if(active.some(x=>!ids.has(x.id)))fail(422,'SOURCE_COVERAGE','Assess every active registered source in the included campuses.');
 if(a.base_year>Number(p.end_date.slice(0,4)))fail(422,'BASE_YEAR','The baseline year cannot be after this inventory period.');
 for(const x of a.sources){const source=await s.get('u_c_sources',x.sourceId);if(!a.campus_ids.includes(source.campus_id))fail(422,'SOURCE_BOUNDARY','Every declared source must belong to an included campus.');
  if(source.active_from>p.end_date||source.active_to<p.start_date)fail(422,'SOURCE_DATES','Do not include inactive-period sources in this period plan.');
  await s.evidence(x.evidenceIds,x.decision==='NO_ACTIVITY');x.sourceSnapshot=source;}
 const byCheck=new Map(a.screening.map(x=>[x.campusId+':'+x.code,x]));
 for(const cid of a.campus_ids)for(const c of CHECKLIST){const row=byCheck.get(cid+':'+c.code);if(!row)fail(422,'SCREENING_REQUIRED','Complete the university Scope 1/2 source checklist for every included campus.');
  const matching=a.sources.filter(x=>x.sourceSnapshot.campus_id===cid&&(c.kind==='THERMAL_ENERGY'?['PURCHASED_STEAM','PURCHASED_HEAT','PURCHASED_COOLING'].includes(x.sourceSnapshot.kind):x.sourceSnapshot.kind===c.kind));
  if(c.kind!=='SOLAR_ATTRIBUTES'&&row.decision==='PRESENT'&&!matching.length)fail(422,'UNREGISTERED_SOURCE','A present source category must have at least one registered, assessed source.');
  if(c.kind!=='SOLAR_ATTRIBUTES'&&row.decision==='NOT_APPLICABLE'&&matching.some(x=>x.decision==='INCLUDED'))fail(422,'SCREENING_CONFLICT','An included source contradicts a not-applicable checklist answer.');}
 if(a.screening.some(x=>!a.campus_ids.includes(x.campusId)))fail(422,'SCREENING_CAMPUS','Checklist rows must refer to included campuses only.');await s.evidence(a.evidence_ids,false);return a;
}
export async function createBoundary(s,b){role(s.user,['ADMIN']);let a=rules.boundaryInput(b);const p=await lockPeriod(s,a.period_id);a=await validateBoundary(s,a,p);
 const prior=await s.rows('u_c_boundaries',{period_id:p.id},100);if(prior.some(r=>r.status==='DRAFT'))fail(409,'PENDING_BOUNDARY','Edit or review the existing draft plan before creating another.');
 const revision=prior.reduce((n,r)=>Math.max(n,r.revision),0)+1;const r=await s.insert('u_c_boundaries',{...a,revision,status:'DRAFT',approved_by:null,created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_BOUNDARY_DRAFTED',r.id,{revision,scope2Mode:r.scope2_mode});return r;}
export async function editBoundary(s,rid,b){role(s.user,['ADMIN']);const {version:expected,...input}=b;let a=rules.boundaryInput(input);const seen=await s.get('u_c_boundaries',uuid(rid));if(seen.period_id!==a.period_id)fail(422,'IMMUTABLE_REFERENCE','Boundary reporting period cannot change.');const p=await lockPeriod(s,a.period_id),old=await s.get('u_c_boundaries',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,expected);authorOnly(s.user,old);if(old.status!=='DRAFT')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Create a new boundary revision after review.');a=await validateBoundary(s,a,p);const r=await s.update('u_c_boundaries',old.id,a);await s.audit('C_BOUNDARY_EDITED',r.id);return r;}
export async function reviewBoundary(s,rid,action,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);fields(b,['version','reason']);const seen=await s.get('u_c_boundaries',uuid(rid)),p=await lockPeriod(s,seen.period_id),old=await s.get('u_c_boundaries',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,b.version);independent(s.user,old);if(old.status!=='DRAFT')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only a draft boundary can be reviewed.');choice(action,['approve','reject'],'action');
 if(action==='reject'){const r=await s.update('u_c_boundaries',old.id,{status:'REJECTED',rejection_reason:reason(b.reason)});await s.audit('C_BOUNDARY_REJECTED',r.id);return r;}
 await validateBoundary(s,structuredClone(old),p);await s.evidence(old.evidence_ids,true);
 if((await liveRecords(s,p.id)).length)fail(409,'ACTIVE_CARBON_RECORDS','Void calculated rows and cancel drafts before replacing their accounting boundary. Existing snapshots are never silently reinterpreted.');
 const legacy=(await s.rows('activities',{period_id:p.id},5000)).filter(r=>r.status!=='REJECTED');const prior=(await s.rows('u_emissions',{period_id:p.id,scope:['SCOPE_1','SCOPE_2']},5000)).filter(r=>r.status!=='REJECTED');
 if(legacy.length||prior.length)fail(409,'LEGACY_SCOPE12_EXISTS','This period contains legacy Scope 1/2 records. Use a clean period or a reviewed migration; do not post the same consumption in two ledgers.');
 const r=await s.update('u_c_boundaries',old.id,{status:'APPROVED',approved_by:s.user.id});if(!await s.count('u_c_period_modes',{period_id:p.id}))await s.insert('u_c_period_modes',{period_id:p.id,boundary_id:r.id,activated_by:s.user.id});
 await s.audit('C_BOUNDARY_APPROVED',r.id,{revision:r.revision,mode:'EXCLUSIVE_SCOPE12',scope2Mode:r.scope2_mode});return r;}
async function validateInstrument(s,a){const p=await s.period(a.period_id),tenant=await s.get('tenants',s.tenant),factor=await s.get('u_c_factors',a.factor_id);
 if(a.valid_from<p.start_date||a.valid_to>p.end_date)fail(422,'INSTRUMENT_PERIOD','Consumption eligibility dates must be inside the selected reporting period.');
 if(factor.status!=='APPROVED'||factor.use!=='MARKET_CONTRACT'||factor.unit!=='kWh'||factor.region!==a.region||factor.valid_from>a.valid_from||factor.valid_to<a.valid_to)fail(422,'INSTRUMENT_FACTOR','Use an approved contractual energy factor with matching region and complete eligibility dates.');
 if(a.kind==='EAC'&&factor.substance!=='ELECTRICITY')fail(422,'EAC_COMMODITY','EAC instruments here are electricity only; thermal supplier factors need their own reviewed product allocation.');
 const normalize=v=>v.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase();if(normalize(a.beneficiary)!==normalize(tenant.name))fail(422,'INSTRUMENT_BENEFICIARY','Retirement/allocation beneficiary must match this university name.');await s.evidence(a.evidence_ids,true);return factor;}
export async function createInstrument(s,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);const a=rules.instrumentInput(b);await lockPeriod(s,a.period_id);await validateInstrument(s,a);
 if(await s.count('u_c_instruments',{serial_key:a.serial_key}))fail(409,'DUPLICATE_INSTRUMENT','This registry and serial are already registered for the tenant.');
 const r=await s.insert('u_c_instruments',{...a,status:'DRAFT',approved_by:null,created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_INSTRUMENT_DRAFTED',r.id,{serialKey:r.serial_key,quantityKwh:r.quantity_kwh});return r;}
export async function editInstrument(s,rid,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);const {version:expected,...input}=b,a=rules.instrumentInput(input),seen=await s.get('u_c_instruments',uuid(rid));if(a.period_id!==seen.period_id||a.serial_key!==seen.serial_key)fail(422,'IMMUTABLE_REFERENCE','Keep the registered period, registry and serial.');await lockPeriod(s,seen.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_instruments',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,expected);authorOnly(s.user,old);if(!['DRAFT','REJECTED'].includes(old.status))fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Approved instruments are immutable.');await validateInstrument(s,a);const r=await s.update('u_c_instruments',old.id,{...a,status:'DRAFT',rejection_reason:null});await s.audit('C_INSTRUMENT_EDITED',r.id);return r;}
export async function reviewInstrument(s,rid,action,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);fields(b,['version','reason']);const seen=await s.get('u_c_instruments',uuid(rid));await lockPeriod(s,seen.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_instruments',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,b.version);independent(s.user,old);if(old.status!=='DRAFT')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Instrument is not awaiting review.');choice(action,['approve','reject'],'action');if(action==='approve')await validateInstrument(s,old);
 const r=await s.update('u_c_instruments',old.id,{status:action==='approve'?'APPROVED':'REJECTED',approved_by:action==='approve'?s.user.id:null,rejection_reason:action==='reject'?reason(b.reason):null});await s.audit('C_INSTRUMENT_'+r.status,r.id,{review:'INTERNAL_ONLY_NOT_REGISTRY_VALIDATED'});return r;}
export async function preflight(s,a,{excludeId=null,forApproval=false}={}){
 const period=await s.period(a.period_id),boundary=await activeBoundary(s,a.period_id),source=await s.get('u_c_sources',a.source_id);if(!forApproval)await sourceAccess(s,source);
 const decision=boundary.sources.find(x=>x.sourceId===source.id);if(decision?.decision!=='INCLUDED')fail(422,'SOURCE_NOT_INCLUDED','Only included sources from the approved boundary can produce inventory records.');
 if(a.interval_start<period.start_date||a.interval_end>period.end_date||a.interval_start<source.active_from||a.interval_end>source.active_to)fail(422,'DATE_OUTSIDE_PERIOD','The entire interval must be inside the source active dates and reporting period.');
 const q=rules.normalizedQuantity(a.quantity_input,source);decimal(q.quantity,'derived quantity',6,true);if(scaled(q.quantity)===0n)reason(a.zero_reason);
 const factor=await s.get('u_c_factors',a.factor_id);rules.checkFactor(a,source,factor,[source.scope==='SCOPE_1'?'DIRECT':'LOCATION']);const evidence=await s.evidence(a.evidence_ids,forApproval);
 const live=await liveRecords(s,period.id);for(const old of live){if(old.id===excludeId)continue;if(old.source_id===source.id&&overlaps(old,a))fail(409,'OVERLAPPING_SOURCE_INTERVAL','This source already has an overlapping active interval. Split independent meters/fuels into distinct registered sources or use an approved correction.');}
 const duplicate=await s.rows('u_c_records',{external_key:a.external_key},1);if(duplicate.some(r=>r.id!==excludeId))fail(409,'DUPLICATE_SOURCE_KEY','This source/document key is already registered.');
 if(a.replaces_id){const replaced=await s.get('u_c_records',a.replaces_id);if(replaced.source_id!==a.source_id||replaced.period_id!==a.period_id)fail(422,'CORRECTION_REFERENCE','A replacement must use the same source and period.');if(!await s.count('u_c_voids',{record_id:replaced.id,status:'APPROVED'}))fail(409,'VOID_REQUIRED','An independently approved void is required before replacement.');}
 const primary=rules.calculateGas(q.quantity,factor);let market=null;
 if(source.scope==='SCOPE_1'||boundary.scope2_mode==='LOCATION_ONLY'){if(a.market_allocations.length||a.fallback_factor_id)fail(422,'MARKET_NOT_APPLICABLE','Do not apply market instruments to Scope 1 or a location-only boundary.');}
 else {
  const parts=[];for(const allocation of [...a.market_allocations].sort((a,b)=>a.instrumentId.localeCompare(b.instrumentId))){const instrument=await s.get('u_c_instruments',allocation.instrumentId);
   if(instrument.status!=='APPROVED'||instrument.period_id!==period.id||instrument.region!==source.region||instrument.valid_from>a.interval_start||instrument.valid_to<a.interval_end)fail(422,'INSTRUMENT_MISMATCH','Use approved same-period instruments with matching market and complete consumption eligibility dates.');
   const f=await s.get('u_c_factors',instrument.factor_id);rules.checkFactor(a,source,f,['MARKET_CONTRACT']);
   const used=await s.carbonAllocationUsed(instrument.id);if(scaled(used)+scaled(allocation.quantityKwh)>scaled(instrument.quantity_kwh))fail(409,'INSTRUMENT_EXHAUSTED','Allocation exceeds the instrument remaining eligible quantity. Drafts do not reserve instruments.');
   parts.push({...allocation,factor:f,instrument});}
  let fallback=null;if(a.fallback_factor_id){fallback=await s.get('u_c_factors',a.fallback_factor_id);rules.checkFactor(a,source,fallback,['RESIDUAL','GRID_FALLBACK']);reason(a.fallback_reason);if(fallback.use==='GRID_FALLBACK'){const residuals=await s.rows('u_c_factors',{kind:source.kind,substance:source.substance,unit:source.unit,region:source.region,use:'RESIDUAL',status:'APPROVED'},1000);if(residuals.some(f=>f.valid_from<=a.interval_start&&f.valid_to>=a.interval_end))fail(422,'RESIDUAL_AVAILABLE','An approved matching residual-mix factor is registered. Do not silently replace it with the grid-average fallback.');}}
  market=rules.calculateMarket(q.quantity,parts,fallback);
 }
 return {period,boundary,source,factor,quantity:q.quantity,quantityMethod:q,primary,market,evidence};
}
export async function previewRecord(s,b){role(s.user,WRITE);const a=rules.recordInput(b),result=await preflight(s,a);return {...result,persisted:false,instrumentReservation:false};}
async function insertRecord(s,a,check){const r=await s.insert('u_c_records',{...a,boundary_id:check.boundary.id,campus_id:check.source.campus_id,kind:check.source.kind,scope:check.source.scope,unit:check.source.unit,quantity:check.quantity,status:'DRAFT',approved_by:null,created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_RECORD_DRAFTED',r.id,{sourceId:r.source_id,externalKey:r.external_key,quantity:r.quantity});return r;}
export async function createRecord(s,b){role(s.user,WRITE);const a=rules.recordInput(b);await lockPeriod(s,a.period_id);return insertRecord(s,a,await preflight(s,a));}
export async function editRecord(s,rid,b){role(s.user,WRITE);const {version:expected,...input}=b,a=rules.recordInput(input),seen=await s.get('u_c_records',uuid(rid));recordAccess(s,seen);if(a.period_id!==seen.period_id||a.source_id!==seen.source_id||a.replaces_id!==seen.replaces_id)fail(422,'IMMUTABLE_REFERENCE','Keep the original source, period and correction reference.');await lockPeriod(s,a.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_records',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,expected);authorOnly(s.user,old);if(!['DRAFT','REJECTED'].includes(old.status))fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only draft or rejected entries can be edited.');const check=await preflight(s,a,{excludeId:old.id});const r=await s.update('u_c_records',old.id,{...a,boundary_id:check.boundary.id,quantity:check.quantity,status:'DRAFT',rejection_reason:null});await s.audit('C_RECORD_EDITED',r.id);return r;}
export async function getRecord(s,rid){const r=await s.get('u_c_records',uuid(rid));recordAccess(s,r);return {...r,calculations:await s.rows('u_c_calculations',{record_id:r.id},1),voids:await s.rows('u_c_voids',{record_id:r.id},100)};}
export async function recordAction(s,rid,action,b){fields(b,['version','reason']);role(s.user,['submit','cancel'].includes(action)?WRITE:REVIEW);const seen=await s.get('u_c_records',uuid(rid));recordAccess(s,seen);await lockPeriod(s,seen.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_records',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,b.version);
 if(['submit','cancel'].includes(action)){authorOnly(s.user,old);if(action==='cancel'){if(!['DRAFT','REJECTED'].includes(old.status))fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only unsubmitted drafts or rejected rows can be cancelled.');const r=await s.update('u_c_records',old.id,{status:'CANCELLED',rejection_reason:reason(b.reason)});await s.audit('C_RECORD_CANCELLED',r.id);return r;}
  if(old.status!=='DRAFT')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only a draft can be submitted.');await preflight(s,old,{excludeId:old.id});await s.evidence(old.evidence_ids,true);const r=await s.update('u_c_records',old.id,{status:'SUBMITTED'});await s.audit('C_RECORD_SUBMITTED',r.id);return r;}
 independent(s.user,old);if(old.status!=='SUBMITTED')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only a submitted record can be reviewed.');
 if(action==='reject'){const r=await s.update('u_c_records',old.id,{status:'REJECTED',rejection_reason:reason(b.reason)});await s.audit('C_RECORD_REJECTED',r.id);return r;}
 if(action!=='approve')fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Unknown record action.');const check=await preflight(s,old,{excludeId:old.id,forApproval:true});if(check.boundary.id!==old.boundary_id)fail(409,'BOUNDARY_CHANGED','Reject and refresh this draft against the new approved boundary.');
 const provenance={schemaVersion:'scope12-1',source:check.source,boundary:{id:check.boundary.id,revision:check.boundary.revision,approach:check.boundary.approach,scope2Mode:check.boundary.scope2_mode,statement:check.boundary.statement},interval:{from:old.interval_start,to:old.interval_end},quantity:check.quantity,quantityInput:old.quantity_input,quantityMethod:check.quantityMethod,factor:check.factor,primary:check.primary,market:check.market,evidence:check.evidence,dataQuality:old.data_quality,assumptions:old.assumptions,zeroReason:old.zero_reason,approvedBy:s.user.id,assurance:'INTERNAL_MAKER_CHECKER_ONLY',notSummable:'LOCATION and MARKET are alternatives; biogenic CO2 is a separate disclosure, not an offset.'};
 const calculation=await s.insert('u_c_calculations',{record_id:old.id,scope1_kg:old.scope==='SCOPE_1'?check.primary.kgCo2e:null,location_kg:old.scope==='SCOPE_2'?check.primary.kgCo2e:null,market_kg:check.market?.kgCo2e??null,biogenic_kg:check.primary.biogenicCo2Kg,provenance});
 for(const a of old.market_allocations)await s.insert('u_c_allocations',{record_id:old.id,instrument_id:a.instrumentId,quantity_kwh:a.quantityKwh});
 const r=await s.update('u_c_records',old.id,{status:'CALCULATED',approved_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_RECORD_CALCULATED',r.id,{calculationId:calculation.id,scope1Kg:calculation.scope1_kg,locationKg:calculation.location_kg,marketKg:calculation.market_kg});return {...r,calculation};
}
export async function requestVoid(s,rid,b){role(s.user,WRITE);fields(b,['version','reason']);const seen=await s.get('u_c_records',uuid(rid));recordAccess(s,seen);await lockPeriod(s,seen.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_records',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,b.version);if(old.status!=='CALCULATED')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only calculated entries can be voided.');if(await s.count('u_c_voids',{record_id:old.id,status:['SUBMITTED','APPROVED']}))fail(409,'EXISTING_VOID','An active void already exists.');const r=await s.insert('u_c_voids',{period_id:old.period_id,record_id:old.id,reason:reason(b.reason),status:'SUBMITTED',approved_by:null,created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_VOID_REQUESTED',r.id,{recordId:old.id});return r;}
export async function reviewVoid(s,rid,action,b){role(s.user,REVIEW);fields(b,['version','reason']);const seen=await s.get('u_c_voids',uuid(rid)),record=await s.get('u_c_records',seen.record_id);await lockPeriod(s,record.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_voids',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,b.version);independent(s.user,old);if(old.status!=='SUBMITTED')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Void is not pending.');choice(action,['approve','reject'],'action');const r=await s.update('u_c_voids',old.id,{status:action==='approve'?'APPROVED':'REJECTED',approved_by:action==='approve'?s.user.id:null,rejection_reason:action==='reject'?reason(b.reason):null});await s.audit('C_VOID_'+r.status,r.id,{recordId:record.id,allocationEffect:action==='approve'?'Released for this same reporting period only':'No release'});return r;}
export async function createAction(s,b){role(s.user,['ADMIN','ENTRY','REVIEWER']);fields(b,['periodId','campusId','sourceId','title','severity','ownerId','dueDate','description','evidenceIds']);await lockPeriod(s,uuid(b.periodId));await s.location(uuid(b.campusId));await s.userRef(uuid(b.ownerId),['ADMIN','ENTRY','REVIEWER']);if(b.sourceId){const source=await s.get('u_c_sources',uuid(b.sourceId));if(source.campus_id!==b.campusId)fail(422,'SOURCE_CAMPUS','Source and action campus differ.');await sourceAccess(s,source);}const evidence=evidenceIds(b.evidenceIds);await s.evidence(evidence,false);
 const r=await s.insert('u_c_actions',{period_id:b.periodId,campus_id:b.campusId,source_id:b.sourceId||null,title:text(b.title,'title',180),severity:choice(b.severity,['LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH','CRITICAL'],'severity'),owner_id:b.ownerId,due_date:day(b.dueDate),description:reason(b.description),evidence_ids:evidence,status:'OPEN',created_by:s.user.id});await s.audit('C_ACTION_CREATED',r.id);return r;}
export async function actionTransition(s,rid,action,b){role(s.user,action==='resolve'?['ADMIN','ENTRY','REVIEWER']:REVIEW);fields(b,['version','reason','evidenceIds']);const seen=await s.get('u_c_actions',uuid(rid));await lockPeriod(s,seen.period_id);const old=await s.get('u_c_actions',seen.id,{lock:true});version(old,b.version);const why=reason(b.reason);let values;
 if(action==='resolve'){if(s.user.id!==old.owner_id&&s.user.role!=='ADMIN')fail(403,'OWNER_REQUIRED','Only the assigned owner or administrator can resolve this action.');if(old.status!=='OPEN')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Only an open action can be resolved.');const ids=evidenceIds(b.evidenceIds);await s.evidence(ids,true);values={status:'RESOLVED',resolution:why,resolved_by:s.user.id,evidence_ids:ids};}
 else if(action==='close'){if(old.status!=='RESOLVED')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Resolve the action with evidence before closing it.');if(old.resolved_by===s.user.id)fail(403,'SELF_APPROVAL','A different reviewer must close the corrective action.');await s.evidence(old.evidence_ids,true);values={status:'CLOSED',closed_by:s.user.id};}
 else if(action==='reopen'){if(old.status==='OPEN')fail(409,'INVALID_STATE','Action is already open.');values={status:'OPEN',closed_by:null,resolved_by:null};}

Gas details and source coverage are in the frozen JSON snapshot.</p>':'')+'<h2>University indicators</h2>'+table(['Indicator','Value','Unit'],snap.metricSummary.map(m=>[m.code,m.value??'See individual observations',m.unit]))+'<h2>Scope 3 coverage</h2>'+table(['Category','Decision','Records','Rationale'],snap.scope3Coverage.map(c=>[c.number+'. '+c.name,c.decision,c.recordCount,c.rationale||'Not assessed']))+'<h2>Calculated ledger</h2>'+table(columns,snap.inventoryRows.map(row=>columns.map(c=>row[c])))+'<footer><p>Snapshot SHA-256: <code>'+esc(r.snapshot_hash)+'</code></p><p>Data as of '+esc(snap.asOf)+'. export const INSIGHTS=['EMISSIONS_SUMMARY','MISSING_SUBMISSIONS','TOP_HOTSPOTS','EVIDENCE_GAPS','SCOPE3_COVERAGE'];
export async function insights(s,b){fields(b,['periodId','questionId']);choice(b.questionId,INSIGHTS,'questionId');const pid=uuid(b.periodId);await s.period(pid,false);let facts,citations=[];
  if(b.questionId==='MISSING_SUBMISSIONS'){const rows=await s.missingTasks(pid);facts={openTasks:await s.count('u_tasks',{period_id:pid,status:'OPEN'}),tasks:rows.slice(0,100),truncated:rows.length>100};citations=rows.slice(0,100).map(r=>({type:'task',id:r.id,path:`/api/v2/university/tasks/${r.id}`}));}
  else {const rows=await s.inventory(pid),summary=inventorySummary(rows);citations=rows.map(r=>({type:'calculation',id:r.id,recordId:r.record_id,path:r.ledger==='CORE'?`/api/v2/activities/${r.record_id}`:r.ledger==='CARBON_SCOPE12'?`/api/v2/university/carbon/records/${r.record_id}`:`/api/v2/university/emissions/${r.record_id}`}));
    if(b.questionId==='EMISSIONS_SUMMARY')facts=summary;
    if(b.questionId==='TOP_HOTSPOTS')facts={categories:summary.categories.slice(0,10),definition:'Largest recorded emission categories, not a recommendation or verified reduction potential.'};
    if(b.questionId==='EVIDENCE_GAPS')facts={recordsWithoutEvidence:rows.filter(r=>r.evidence_count===0).map(r=>({id:r.record_id,scope:r.scope,category:r.category,ledger:r.ledger})),note:'Absence of a linked document is not proof that the record is false.'};
    if(b.questionId==='SCOPE3_COVERAGE')facts=coverage(await s.rows('u_scope3_screenings',{period_id:pid},15),rows);}
  return {questionId:b.questionId,periodId:pid,asOf:new Date().toISOString(),engine:'DETERMINISTIC_SQL_NOT_LLM',facts,citations,generatedNarrative:false,note:'These are traceable database facts. No free-form SQL, external AI model, OCR claim or autonomous action is used.'};}

  return r.file?{file:data}:{data,status:r.status||200};}
export async function portalDispatch(pool,{header,body=null,ip,requestId}){await rateLimit(pool,'university-portal-ip:'+ip,60,60);const parsed=collaboration.parseCapability(header);await rateLimit(pool,'university-capability:'+hash(parsed.token),30,60);
  return universityTx(pool,{tenant_id:parsed.tenantId,id:null,role:'CAPABILITY',requestId},s=>collaboration.portal(s,parsed,body));}

import { operationsConfig } from './operations/crypto.mjs';
import { processMail } from './operations/mail.mjs';
import { processSweep } from './operations/reminders.mjs';
import { processExport } from './operations/exports.mjs';
import { processOcr } from './operations/ocr.mjs';
import { extractImport, XLSX_MIME } from './ingestion/parser.mjs';
import { setTimeout as sleep } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { config } from './config.mjs';
import { id } from './core.mjs';
import { createPool, assertRuntimeRole, tenantTx } from './db.mjs';
import { createStorage } from './storage.mjs';
import { scanWithClamd, extractBounded } from './scanner.mjs';
import { claimJob, failJob, processCalculation, processInvoice, reconcileUpload, ownedJob, done } from './jobs.mjs';
const ops = operationsConfig();
const cfg = config(process.env, true), pool = await createPool(cfg), storage = await createStorage(cfg), workerId = id();
await assertRuntimeRole(pool, true);
await storage.check();
let stopping = false;
process.on('SIGINT', () => { stopping = true; });
process.on('SIGTERM', () => { stopping = true; });
console.log(JSON.stringify({ event: 'worker_started', workerId }));
let maintenance = 0, heartbeatRunning = false;
const heartbeat = async () => { if (heartbeatRunning)
    return; heartbeatRunning = true; try {
    await pool.query('INSERT INTO cs.worker_heartbeats(worker_id) VALUES($1) ON CONFLICT(worker_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now()', [workerId]);
}
catch {
    console.error(JSON.stringify({ event: 'heartbeat_failed', workerId }));
}
finally {
    heartbeatRunning = false;
} };
await heartbeat();
const heartbeatTimer = setInterval(heartbeat, 15000);
heartbeatTimer.unref();
try {
    while (!stopping) {
        let job;
        try {
            await heartbeat();
            if (Date.now() - maintenance > 60000) {
                maintenance = Date.now();
                await pool.query('DELETE FROM cs.rate_buckets WHERE bucket_key IN (SELECT bucket_key FROM cs.rate_buckets WHERE expires_at<now() LIMIT 1000)');
                await pool.query("DELETE FROM cs.worker_heartbeats WHERE updated_at<now()-interval '1 day'");
            }
            job = await claimJob(pool, cfg.leaseSeconds);
            if (!job) {
                await sleep(cfg.workerPollMs);
                continue;
            }
            if (job.kind === 'CALCULATE')
                await processCalculation(pool, job);
            else if (job.kind === 'SCAN_INVOICE')
                await processInvoice(pool, storage, bytes => scanWithClamd(bytes, cfg), (bytes,mime) => [XLSX_MIME,'text/csv','application/pdf'].includes(mime) ? extractImport(bytes,mime) : extractBounded(bytes,mime), job);
            else if (job.kind === 'OPS_SWEEP') await processSweep(pool,job,ops);
            else if (job.kind === 'SEND_MAIL') await processMail(pool,job,ops);
            else if (job.kind === 'BUILD_EXPORT') await processExport(pool,storage,job,ops);
            else if (job.kind === 'OCR_DOCUMENT') await processOcr(pool,storage,job,ops);
            else if (job.kind === 'RECONCILE_UPLOAD') {
                // Reconciliation is idempotent; acknowledge only with the current fencing token.
                await tenantTx(pool, job.tenant_id, c => ownedJob(c, job));
                await reconcileUpload(pool, storage, job.tenant_id, job.entity_id);
                await tenantTx(pool, job.tenant_id, async (c) => { await ownedJob(c, job); await done(c, job); });
            }
            console.log(JSON.stringify({ event: 'job_done', jobId: job.id, kind: job.kind }));
        }
        catch (error) {
            if (job) {
                const table=({SEND_MAIL:'u_o_mail',BUILD_EXPORT:'u_o_exports',OCR_DOCUMENT:'u_o_ocr_runs'})[job.kind];
                if(table)await tenantTx(pool,job.tenant_id,async c=>{await ownedJob(c,job);await c.query(`UPDATE cs.${table} SET status='FAILED',error_code=$3 WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status NOT IN ('${table==='u_o_mail'?'SENT':'COMPLETE'}'${table==='u_o_exports'?",'APPROVED','REJECTED','READY'":table==='u_o_mail'?",'CAPTURED','CANCELLED'":",'CANCELLED'"})`,[job.tenant_id,job.entity_id,/^[A-Z_]{2,50}$/.test(error?.code||'')?error.code:'PROCESSING_FAILED']);}).catch(()=>{});
            }
            if (job)
                await failJob(pool, job, error).catch(() => { });
            console.error(JSON.stringify({ event: 'job_error', jobId: job?.id, code: error?.code || 'PROCESSING_FAILED' }));
            await sleep(cfg.workerPollMs);
        }
    }
}
finally {
    clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM cs.worker_heartbeats WHERE worker_id=$1', [workerId]).catch(() => { });
    await pool.end();
    storage.close();
}

async function clamFixture(result, fn) { let received = Buffer.alloc(0), done = false; const server = net.createServer(socket => { let data = Buffer.alloc(0), header = false; socket.on('data', chunk => { data = Buffer.concat([data, chunk]); if (!header) {
    const n = data.indexOf(0);
    if (n < 0)
        return;
    assert.equal(data.subarray(0, n).toString(), 'zINSTREAM');
    header = true;
    data = data.subarray(n + 1);

    const n = data.readUInt32BE(0);
    if (data.length < 4 + n)
        return;
    data = data.subarray(4);
    if (n === 0) {
        done = true;
        socket.end(result + '\0');
        return;
    }
    received = Buffer.concat([received, data.subarray(0, n)]);
    data = data.subarray(n);
} }); }); await new Promise(r => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); try {
    await fn({ clamHost: '127.0.0.1', clamPort: server.address().port, scanTimeoutMs: 2000 }, () => ({ received, done }));
}
finally {
    await new Promise(r => server.close(r));
} }

test('electricity exports do not subtract gross imports',()=>{const r=c.quantityPreview({mode:'ELECTRICITY_BALANCE',grossImportsKwh:'100',onsiteGenerationKwh:'40',exportsKwh:'10'});assert.equal(r.quantity,'100.000000');assert.equal(r.campusUseKwh,'130.000000');});
test('negative campus balance must be reconciled',()=>throws(()=>c.quantityPreview({mode:'ELECTRICITY_BALANCE',grossImportsKwh:'1',onsiteGenerationKwh:'1',exportsKwh:'5'}),'NEGATIVE_BALANCE'));
test('factor gas breakdown computes CO2 CH4 N2O exactly',()=>{const f=c.factorInput(factorBody({components:[{gas:'CO2',massPerUnit:'2',gwp:'1'},{gas:'CH4',massPerUnit:'0.01',gwp:'28'},{gas:'N2O',massPerUnit:'0.001',gwp:'265'}]}));const r=c.calculateGas('100',f);assert.equal(r.kgCo2e,'254.500000');assert.equal(r.gases.length,3);assert.equal(r.gasBreakdownAvailable,true);});

test('market allocation computes remaining consumption with residual',()=>{const zero=c.factorInput(factorBody({components:[{gas:'CO2E',massPerUnit:'0',gwp:'1'}],zeroReason:note})),res=c.factorInput(factorBody({components:[{gas:'CO2E',massPerUnit:'0.9',gwp:'1'}]}));assert.equal(c.calculateMarket('100',[{quantityKwh:'40',factor:zero}],res).kgCo2e,'54.000000');});
test('unmatched market quantity cannot be silently zero',()=>throws(()=>c.calculateMarket('100',[],null),'UNCOVERED_MARKET_LOAD'));
test('market over-allocation rejected',()=>assert.throws(()=>c.calculateMarket('1',[{quantityKwh:'2',factor:c.factorInput(factorBody())}],null)));
test('location commodity cannot be arbitrary',()=>throws(()=>c.sourceInput(sourceBody(fixture(),{kind:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',substance:'DIESEL',unit:'kWh'})),'COMMODITY_MISMATCH'));
test('all source kinds declare scope and unit',()=>{assert.equal(Object.keys(SOURCE_KINDS).length,10);for(const x of Object.values(SOURCE_KINDS))assert.ok(x.scope&&x.units.length);});
test('ten supplementary definitions are distinct and non-emissions records',()=>{assert.equal(EXTRA_KPIS.length,10);assert.equal(new Set(EXTRA_KPIS.map(k=>k.code)).size,10);});
test('instrument requires quality checks rather than checkbox-only claim',()=>{const f=fixture();const b=instrumentBody(f,f.actors.ADMIN.id);delete b.qualityChecks[QUALITY_CRITERIA[0]];assert.throws(()=>c.instrumentInput(b));});
test('instrument cannot claim a future retirement',()=>throws(()=>c.instrumentInput(instrumentBody(fixture(),fixture().actors.ADMIN.id,{retiredOn:'2099-01-01'})),'FUTURE_RETIREMENT'));
test('same serial normalized independent of whitespace and case',()=>{const f=fixture(),a=c.instrumentInput(instrumentBody(f,f.actors.ADMIN.id,{registry:'Registry',serial:'abc 123'})),b=c.instrumentInput(instrumentBody(f,f.actors.ADMIN.id,{registry:'REGISTRY',serial:'ABC123'}));assert.equal(a.serial_key,b.serial_key);});
test('coverage reports leading and trailing missing days',()=>assert.deepEqual(c.gaps('2026-01-01','2026-01-31',[{interval_start:'2026-01-10',interval_end:'2026-01-20'}]),[{from:'2026-01-01',to:'2026-01-09'},{from:'2026-01-21',to:'2026-01-31'}]));

## scale-api/tests/carbon/memory.mjs

```javascript
/** Test double: does NOT execute SQL, RLS, distributed locks or real object storage. */
import {MemoryStore,fixture as baseFixture} from '../university/memory-store.mjs';
import {id} from '../../src/core.mjs';
import {sum} from '../../src/university/core.mjs';
import {CHECKLIST,QUALITY_CRITERIA} from '../../src/university/carbon/catalog.mjs';
import * as svc from '../../src/university/carbon/service.mjs';
export class CarbonMemory extends MemoryStore {
 for(u){return new CarbonMemory(this.state,u);}
 async insert(t,d){this.state.tables[t]||=[];return super.insert(t,d);}
 async carbonAllocationUsed(i){const allocations=await this.rows('u_c_allocations',{instrument_id:i},5000),live=await this.carbonActiveAll();return sum(allocations.filter(a=>live.some(r=>r.record_id===a.record_id)).map(a=>a.quantity_kwh));}
 async carbonActiveAll(){const records=await this.rows('u_c_records',{status:'CALCULATED'},5000),out=[];for(const r of records){if(await this.count('u_c_voids',{record_id:r.id,status:'APPROVED'}))continue;const c=(await this.rows('u_c_calculations',{record_id:r.id},1))[0];if(c)out.push({...r,...c,record_id:r.id,id:c.id,evidence_count:r.evidence_ids.length});}return out;}
 async carbonActive(p){return (await this.carbonActiveAll()).filter(r=>r.period_id===p);}
 async inventory(p){return [...await super.inventory(p),...(await this.carbonActive(p)).map(r=>({...r,kg_co2e:r.scope1_kg??r.location_kg,category:r.kind,scope3_category:null,activity_date:r.interval_end,ledger:'CARBON_SCOPE12'}))];}
}
export function fixture(){const f=baseFixture();f.s=new CarbonMemory(f.state,f.actors.ADMIN);return f;}
export const note='SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY - independently reviewed fixture assumption';
export function sourceBody(f,extra={}){return {campusId:f.campus,ownerId:f.actors.ENTRY.id,code:'SOURCE_'+id().slice(0,8).toUpperCase(),name:'Synthetic boiler',kind:'STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',substance:'DIESEL',unit:'litre',region:'TEST',facilityType:'ACADEMIC',activeFrom:'2026-04-01',activeTo:'2027-03-31',description:note,...extra};}
export function factorBody(extra={}){return {name:'Synthetic all-gas combustion factor',kind:'STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',substance:'DIESEL',unit:'litre',use:'DIRECT',components:[{gas:'CO2E',massPerUnit:'2.68',gwp:'1'}],gwpBasis:note,source:note,sourceUrl:'https://example.invalid/synthetic-factor',region:'TEST',boundary:note,versionLabel:'TEST-'+id(),validFrom:'2026-04-01',validTo:'2027-03-31',...extra};}
export function boundaryBody(f,sources,extra={}){return {periodId:f.period,campusIds:[f.campus],campusExclusions:[],approach:'OPERATIONAL_CONTROL',statement:note,baseYear:2026,recalculationPolicy:note,scope2Mode:'DUAL',scope2Rationale:note,sources:sources.map(s=>({sourceId:s.id,decision:'INCLUDED',rationale:note,frequency:'ANNUAL',evidenceIds:[]})),screening:CHECKLIST.map(c=>({campusId:f.campus,code:c.code,decision:sources.some(s=>s.kind===c.kind||(c.kind==='THERMAL_ENERGY'&&s.kind.startsWith('PURCHASED_')&&s.kind!=='PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY'))?'PRESENT':'NOT_APPLICABLE',rationale:note})),evidenceIds:[f.document.id],...extra};}
export function recordBody(f,source,factor,extra={}){return {periodId:f.period,sourceId:source.id,intervalStart:'2026-04-01',intervalEnd:'2027-03-31',externalKey:'test:'+id(),description:note,quantityInput:{mode:'DIRECT',quantity:'100',unit:source.unit},factorId:factor.id,evidenceIds:[f.document.id],dataQuality:'MEASURED',...extra};}
export async function approvedFactor(f,body=factorBody()){const r=await svc.createFactor(f.s,body);return svc.reviewFactor(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),r.id,'approve',{version:r.version});}
export async function activate(f,sources,extra={}){const r=await svc.createBoundary(f.s,boundaryBody(f,sources,extra));return svc.reviewBoundary(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),r.id,'approve',{version:r.version});}
export async function readyFixture(kind='DIRECT'){const f=fixture();f.source=await svc.createSource(f.s,sourceBody(f,kind==='ENERGY'?{kind:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',substance:'ELECTRICITY',unit:'kWh'}:{}));f.factor=await approvedFactor(f,factorBody(kind==='ENERGY'?{kind:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',substance:'ELECTRICITY',unit:'kWh',use:'LOCATION',components:[{gas:'CO2E',massPerUnit:'0.7',gwp:'1'}]}:{}));f.boundary=await activate(f,[f.source]);if(kind==='ENERGY'){f.fallback=await approvedFactor(f,factorBody({kind:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',substance:'ELECTRICITY',unit:'kWh',use:'RESIDUAL',components:[{gas:'CO2E',massPerUnit:'0.9',gwp:'1'}]}));}return f;}
export async function calculate(f,body){const e=f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY);let r=await svc.createRecord(e,body);r=await svc.recordAction(e,r.id,'submit',{version:r.version});return svc.recordAction(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),r.id,'approve',{version:r.version});}
export function instrumentBody(f,factorId,extra={}){return {periodId:f.period,name:'Synthetic retired EAC',kind:'EAC',registry:'TEST ONLY',serial:'TEST-'+id(),beneficiary:'Synthetic Test University',region:'TEST',quantityKwh:'40',validFrom:'2026-04-01',validTo:'2027-03-31',vintageFrom:'2026-04-01',vintageTo:'2027-03-31',retiredOn:'2026-04-02',factorId,qualityChecks:Object.fromEntries(QUALITY_CRITERIA.map(k=>[k,{assessment:'PASS',explanation:note}])),evidenceIds:[f.document.id],...extra};}
export async function instrument(f,extra={}){const factor=await approvedFactor(f,factorBody({kind:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',substance:'ELECTRICITY',unit:'kWh',use:'MARKET_CONTRACT',components:[{gas:'CO2E',massPerUnit:'0',gwp:'1'}],zeroReason:note}));let r=await svc.createInstrument(f.s,instrumentBody(f,factor.id,extra));return svc.reviewInstrument(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),r.id,'approve',{version:r.version});}

                    raise ValueError('UI bridge accepts same-fixture relative paths only')

                try:

                        return {'status':response.status,'body':response.read().decode(),'headers':dict(response.headers)}
                except urllib.error.HTTPError as response:
                    return {'status':response.code,'body':response.read().decode(),'headers':dict(response.headers)}
            pg.expose_function('__fixture_http',bridge)
            filename='portal.html' if path.endswith('/portal') else 'index.html'
            html=(root/'public/university'/filename).read_text()

              };
            """)
            pg.add_script_tag(content=(root/'public/university'/('portal.js' if path.endswith('/portal') else 'app.js')).read_text())

            throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in'); return { id: tenant, tenant_id: tenant, role: 'ADMIN' }; }, limit: async () => { }, publicUser: u => u, readiness: async () => ({ ready: true }), metadata: async () => ({ name: 'Tenant A' }), login: async (b) => ({ email: b.email }), createActivity: async (u, b, k) => ({ body: b, key: k }), uploadLimit: async () => { }, upload: async (u, n, m, b, k) => ({ name: n, size: b.length, key: k }), ...overrides };
    const app = createApp({ ...cfg, ...config }, services, { log: () => { } });

test('six individual PDFs -> six reviewed drafts, amount remains separate',async()=>{const f=await fixture({kind:'INVOICE',doc:{mime_type:'application/pdf',original_name:'01.pdf',extraction:await parseFile(await readFile('samples/ingestion/invoices/Demo-Invoice-01.pdf'),'pdf')}});let b=f.batch;const ids=[];for(let n=2;n<=6;n++){const bytes=await readFile('samples/ingestion/invoices/Demo-Invoice-'+String(n).padStart(2,'0')+'.pdf');const d=await f.s.insert('documents',{...f.doc,id:id(),sha256:hash(bytes),original_name:n+'.pdf',extraction:await parseFile(bytes,'pdf')});ids.push(d.id);}await service.attachFiles(f.e,b.id,{version:b.version,documentIds:ids});b=await service.getBatch(f.e,b.id);assert.equal(b.files.length,6);const rows=[];for(const file of b.files){const p=await service.previewFile(f.e,file.id,{version:file.version,plans:[{defaults:plan(f).defaults}]});assert.equal(p.rows.length,1);rows.push(...p.rows);}const r=await review(f,rows);assert.ok(r.items.every(r=>r.status==='READY'),JSON.stringify(r.items.map(r=>r.issues)));const c=await commit(f,r.items);assert.equal(c.imported,6);assert.equal(r.items.reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.normalized.quantity),0),7900);assert.equal(r.items[0].normalized.amountInr,'11250.00');assert.equal((await f.e.inventory(f.period)).length,0);});

/** Synthetic test helpers only. No SQL, storage or virus scanner is exercised here. */
import {id,hash} from '../../src/core.mjs';
import {readyFixture} from '../carbon/memory.mjs';
import * as service from '../../src/ingestion/service.mjs';
import {XLSX_MIME} from '../../src/ingestion/parser.mjs';
export {service};
export function workbook(values,{hiddenRows=[],formulaCells=[],mergedCells={}}={}){return {kind:'WORKBOOK',method:'SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE',sheets:[{name:'Data',hidden:false,rows:values.map((row,i)=>({index:i+1,hidden:hiddenRows.includes(i+1),cells:row.map((v,j)=>({column:String.fromCharCode(65+j),address:String.fromCharCode(65+j)+(i+1),value:v,type:formulaCells.includes(String.fromCharCode(65+j)+(i+1))?'formula':'string',...(mergedCells[String.fromCharCode(65+j)+(i+1)]?{mergedFrom:mergedCells[String.fromCharCode(65+j)+(i+1)]}:{})}))}))}]};}
export const standard=[['Consumption','Unit','Period start','Period end'],['1250','kWh','2026-04-01','2026-04-30'],['1.5','MWh','2026-05-01','2026-05-31']];
export function plan(f,extra={}){return {sheet:'Data',headerRow:1,mapping:{quantity:'A',unit:'B',intervalStart:'C',intervalEnd:'D'},dateOrder:'AUTO',defaults:{sourceId:f.source.id,factorId:f.factor.id,fallbackFactorId:f.fallback?.id,fallbackReason:'Synthetic independently reviewed residual fixture.'},...extra};}
export async function fixture(extra={}){const f=await readyFixture('ENERGY');f.e=f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY);const extraction=extra.extraction||workbook(standard);f.doc=await f.s.insert('documents',{original_name:'synthetic.xlsx',mime_type:XLSX_MIME,file_size:'100',sha256:hash(id()),object_version:'test-only',status:'REVIEW_REQUIRED',scan_result:'CLEAN',uploaded_by:f.actors.ENTRY.id,extraction,...extra.doc});f.batch=await service.createBatch(f.e,{periodId:f.period,name:'Synthetic import batch',kind:extra.kind||'SPREADSHEET',target:extra.target||'CARBON'});const attached=await service.attachFiles(f.e,f.batch.id,{version:f.batch.version,documentIds:[f.doc.id]});f.batch=attached.batch;f.file=attached.files[0];return f;}
export async function preview(f,plans=[plan(f)]){return service.previewFile(f.e,f.file.id,{version:(await f.e.get('u_i_files',f.file.id)).version,plans});}
export async function review(f,rows){return service.reviewRows(f.e,f.batch.id,{quantityMeaningConfirmed:true,items:rows.map(r=>({rowId:r.id,version:r.version,action:'CONFIRM',reason:'Checked the original synthetic evidence.'}))});}
export async function commit(f,rows){return f.e.transaction(s=>service.commitRows(s,f.batch.id,{version:f.state.tables.u_i_batches.find(b=>b.id===f.batch.id).version,rowIds:rows.map(r=>r.id),confirmed:true}));}

```

import test from'node:test';import assert from'node:assert/strict';import{readFile}from'node:fs/promises';import{id}from'../../src/core.mjs';import{ROUTES}from'../../src/university/router.mjs';import{migrationPlan}from'../../scripts/migrate.mjs';import{INGESTION_TABLES}from'../../src/ingestion/schema.mjs';import{httpFixture}from'./http-fixture.mjs';
const p='/api/v2/university/ingestion';async function withHttp(fn){const f=await httpFixture();try{await fn(f);}finally{await f.close();}}
const req=async(f,path,{role='ENTRY',body,key=id(),method=body?'POST':'GET',headers={}}={})=>{const r=await fetch(f.url+path,{method,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer TEST-'+role,...(body?{'Content-Type':'application/json','Idempotency-Key':key}:{}),...headers},body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined});return{r,body:r.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('application/json')?await r.json():await r.text()};};
test('17 unique ingestion operations inherit role and retry metadata',()=>{const a=ROUTES.filter(r=>r.path.includes('/ingestion/'));assert.equal(a.length,17);for(const r of a.filter(r=>r.write)){assert.ok(r.cache);assert.ok(!r.roles.includes('LEADERSHIP'));assert.ok(!r.roles.includes('REVIEWER'));}});
test('migration 4 adds four forced RLS tables and immutable receipts',async()=>{assert.deepEqual((await migrationPlan()).map(m=>m.version),[1,2,3,4,5]);const s=await readFile('migrations/004_ingestion.sql','utf8');for(const t of Object.keys(INGESTION_TABLES))assert.match(s,new RegExp('CREATE TABLE cs.'+t));assert.match(s,/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY/);assert.match(s,/Imported staging receipts are immutable/);assert.match(s,/UNIQUE INDEX u_i_import_receipt/);assert.match(s,/FOREIGN KEY\(tenant_id,batch_id,file_id\)/);});
test('new UI is real static HTTP with CSP and no external scripts',()=>withHttp(async f=>{let r=await fetch(f.url+'/university/imports');assert.equal(r.status,200);assert.match(r.headers.get('content-security-policy'),/script-src 'self'/);assert.match(await r.text(),/Messy files/);for(const path of ['/ingestion/app.js','/ingestion/style.css'])assert.equal((await fetch(f.url+path)).status,200);}));
test('imports require login and do not accept tenant query switching',()=>withHttp(async f=>{assert.equal((await fetch(f.url+p+'/batches')).status,401);const r=await req(f,p+'/batches?tenantId='+f.tenant);assert.equal(r.r.status,422);}));

"""Build inert parser-rejection fixtures in a caller-supplied temporary directory."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, sys, zipfile, io
from openpyxl import Workbook
out=Path(sys.argv[1]);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
w=Workbook();s=w.active;s.append(['Consumption','Unit','Date']);s.append([10,'kWh',datetime.date(2026,5,3)]);s.append(['=1+1','kWh',datetime.date(2026,5,4)]);s.row_dimensions[3].hidden=True;s.merge_cells('D1:F1');s['D1']='Merged title';s['C2'].number_format='yyyy-mm-dd';w.save(out/'dates-formula.xlsx')
source=(out/'dates-formula.xlsx').read_bytes()
def altered(name,add=None,replace=None):
 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(source)) as z,zipfile.ZipFile(out/name,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as o:
  for item in z.infolist():
   val=z.read(item.filename)
   if replace:val=replace(item.filename,val)
   o.writestr(item.filename,val)
  if add:o.writestr(*add)
altered('macro.xlsx',('xl/vbaProject.bin',b'INERT_TEST_NOT_EXECUTABLE'))
altered('traversal.xlsx',('../test.txt',b'INERT_TEST'))
altered('entities.xlsx',replace=lambda n,b: b'<!DOCTYPE root [<!ENTITY x "test">]>'+b if n=='xl/workbook.xml' else b)
altered('external.xlsx',('xl/_rels/test.rels',b'<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="r1" Type="http://example.invalid/test" Target="http://example.invalid/never-fetch" TargetMode="External"/></Relationships>'))
altered('zipbomb.xlsx',('huge.txt',b'0'*2_000_000))
w=Workbook();w.active.cell(2001,1,'outside row cap');w.save(out/'rows.xlsx')
w=Workbook();w.active.cell(1,81,'outside column cap');w.save(out/'columns.xlsx')
def simple_pdf(path,pages=31,text='Synthetic test'):
 """Write a minimal valid multi-page PDF without any third-party PDF dependency."""
 stream=f'BT /F1 12 Tf 20 20 Td ({text}) Tj ET'.encode()
 font=3+2*pages
 objects=[b'<</Type/Catalog/Pages 2 0 R>>',
          f'<</Type/Pages/Kids[{" ".join(f"{3+2*i} 0 R" for i in range(pages))}]/Count {pages}>>'.encode()]
 for i in range(pages):
  objects.append(f'<</Type/Page/Parent 2 0 R/MediaBox[0 0 595 842]/Resources<</Font<</F1 {font} 0 R>>>>/Contents {4+2*i} 0 R>>'.encode())
  objects.append(b'<</Length '+str(len(stream)).encode()+b'>>stream\n'+stream+b'\nendstream')
 objects.append(b'<</Type/Font/Subtype/Type1/BaseFont/Helvetica>>')
 out=bytearray(b'%PDF-1.4\n');offsets=[]
 for number,body in enumerate(objects,start=1):
  offsets.append(len(out));out+=f'{number} 0 obj'.encode()+body+b'endobj\n'
 xref=len(out)
 out+=f'xref\n0 {len(objects)+1}\n'.encode()+b'0000000000 65535 f \n'
 for offset in offsets:out+=f'{offset:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode()
 out+=f'trailer<</Size {len(objects)+1}/Root 1 0 R>>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n'.encode()
 path.write_bytes(bytes(out))
simple_pdf(out/'31pages.pdf')

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

import{workbook,standard}from'./helpers.mjs';

for(const[input,expected]of[['1,25,000','125000.000000'],['12,500.50','12500.500000'],['0005','5.000000'],['0','0.000000'],['1.000001','1.000001']])test('number exact '+input,()=>assert.equal(normalizeNumber(input),expected));

test('decimal comma is explicit',()=>{assert.equal(normalizeNumber('1.250,50','DECIMAL_COMMA'),'1250.500000');assert.throws(()=>normalizeNumber('1.250,50'));});

for(const[input,unit,mult]of[['MWh','kWh','1000'],['litres','litre','1'],['kl','litre','1000'],['tonnes','kg','1000'],['m\u00b3','m3','1'],['%','percent','1']])test('unit '+input,()=>{const u=normalizeUnit(input);assert.equal(u.unit,unit);assert.equal(u.multiplier,mult);});

test('suffix disagreement flags conflict',()=>assert.ok(normalizeValues({quantity:'1.25 MWh',unit:'kWh',activityDate:'2026-05-31'}).issues.some(i=>i.code==='UNIT_CONFLICT')));
test('currency is not consumption',()=>{const r=normalizeValues({amountInr:'INR 12,500.00',unit:'kWh',activityDate:'2026-05-31'});assert.equal(r.normalized.amountInr,'12500.00');assert.ok(r.issues.some(i=>i.code==='MISSING_QUANTITY'));});
test('inverted date interval rejected',()=>assert.ok(normalizeValues({quantity:'2',unit:'kWh',intervalStart:'2026-05-02',intervalEnd:'2026-05-01'}).issues.some(i=>i.code==='DATE_RANGE')));

test('ambiguous header alias not silently chosen',()=>{const e=workbook([['Quantity','Consumption','Unit']]);const s=suggestSheet(e.sheets[0]);assert.equal(s.mapping.quantity,undefined);assert.ok(s.warnings.length);});
test('repeated header and total stay visible but skipped',()=>{const r=workbookRows(workbook([...standard,standard[0],['Grand total','',2750]]),base);assert.equal(r.length,4);assert.equal(r[2].skipReason,'REPEATED_HEADER');assert.equal(r[3].skipReason,'SUMMARY_ROW');});
test('wide month columns unpivot exact periods',()=>{const e=workbook([['Unit','Apr 2026','May 2026'],['litre','20','30']]);const s=suggestSheet(e.sheets[0]);const rows=workbookRows(e,{sheet:'Data',headerRow:1,mapping:{unit:'A'},monthColumns:s.monthColumns.map(({column,intervalStart,intervalEnd})=>({column,intervalStart,intervalEnd}))});assert.equal(rows.length,2);assert.equal(rows[1].normalized.intervalEnd,'2026-05-31');assert.equal(rows[1].normalized.quantity,'30.000000');});
test('unlabelled year is not guessed for monthly layout',()=>assert.equal(monthRange('April'),null));

test('merged quantity cannot be forward-filled',()=>{const e=workbook(standard,{mergedCells:{A3:'A2'}});assert.ok(workbookRows(e,base)[1].issues.some(i=>i.code==='MERGED_VALUE'));});
test('never forward-fill date or quantity',()=>assert.throws(()=>validatePlan({...base,forwardFill:['quantity']})));
test('mapping cannot reuse a column for quantity and amount',()=>assert.throws(()=>validatePlan({...base,mapping:{quantity:'A',amountInr:'A'}})));
test('unknown mapping fields fail closed',()=>assert.throws(()=>validatePlan({...base,mapping:{tenantId:'A'}})));

test('image-only PDF is explicitly manual',async()=>{const e=await parseFile(await readFile('samples/ingestion/Image-Only-Manual-Review.pdf'),'pdf');assert.equal(e.pages[0].status,'MANUAL_REQUIRED');assert.equal(e.ocrAvailable,false);});
test('unavailable parser produces explicit manual fallback not invented fields',async()=>{await assert.rejects(()=>parseFile(Buffer.from('a,b'),'csv',{python:'this-parser-does-not-exist'}),e=>e.code==='PARSER_UNAVAILABLE');const e=await extractImport(Buffer.from('%PDF-broken'),'application/pdf');assert.ok(e.parserError);assert.deepEqual(e.fields,{});});

async function fixture(name){const tenant=id(),campus=id(),period=id(),document=id(),people={},encoded=await passwordHash('Only-integration-fixture-password-123!');await owner.query('BEGIN');try{await owner.query("SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id',$1,true)",[tenant]);await owner.query('INSERT INTO cs.tenants(id,name) VALUES($1,$2)',[tenant,name]);for(const role of ['ADMIN','ENTRY','REVIEWER','LEADERSHIP']){const uid=id();people[role]={id:uid,tenant_id:tenant,role};await owner.query('INSERT INTO cs.users(id,tenant_id,email,name,role,password_hash) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)',[uid,tenant,role.toLowerCase()+'@fixture.example',role,role,encoded]);}await owner.query('INSERT INTO cs.campuses(id,tenant_id,name,code) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4)',[campus,tenant,'SYNTHETIC TEST CAMPUS','TEST']);await owner.query('INSERT INTO cs.periods(id,tenant_id,name,start_date,end_date) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)',[period,tenant,'Synthetic annual period','2026-04-01','2027-03-31']);await owner.query(`INSERT INTO cs.documents(id,tenant_id,original_name,mime_type,file_size,sha256,object_key,object_version,status,scan_result,scan_engine,uploaded_by) VALUES($1,$2,'fixture-only.txt','text/plain',20,$3,$4,'fixture-v1','REVIEW_REQUIRED','CLEAN','TEST_METADATA_NOT_REAL_SCAN',$5)`,[document,tenant,hash('fixture-'+tenant),'fixture/'+id(),people.ENTRY.id]);await owner.query('COMMIT');return {tenant,campus,period,document,...people};}catch(e){await owner.query('ROLLBACK');throw e;}}

/** Real temporary files and checksums; NOT a live pg_dump/object-store restore drill. */
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {mkdtemp,writeFile,readFile,rm,symlink,stat} from 'node:fs/promises';import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';import path from 'node:path';
import {fileHash,saveBackupObject,verifyBundle} from '../../src/operations/backup.mjs';import {hash,id} from '../../src/core.mjs';
async function bundle(){const dir=await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(),'cs-backup-test-')),db=Buffer.from('synthetic dump bytes, not PostgreSQL'),original=Buffer.from('synthetic original evidence');await writeFile(path.join(dir,'database.dump'),db);const row={id:id(),tenant_id:id(),kind:'DOCUMENT',object_key:'private/key',object_version:'exact-v1',size:original.length,sha256:hash(original)};let requested;const item=await saveBackupObject(dir,{get:async(...args)=>{requested=args;return original;}},row,0);const manifest={version:1,complete:true,database:{file:'database.dump',size:db.length,sha256:hash(db)},objects:[item]};const write=()=>writeFile(path.join(dir,'manifest.json'),JSON.stringify(manifest));await write();return {dir,db,original,row,item,manifest,requested,write,close:()=>rm(dir,{recursive:true,force:true})};}
test('backup preserves exact referenced version, hash, length and private file mode',async()=>{const b=await bundle();try{assert.deepEqual(b.requested,[b.row.object_key,'exact-v1',b.original.length]);const result=await verifyBundle(b.dir);assert.equal(result.objects,1);assert.equal(result.restoreExecuted,false);assert.equal(result.encryptedByApplication,false);assert.equal(await fileHash(path.join(b.dir,b.item.file)),b.row.sha256);if(process.platform!=='win32')assert.equal((await stat(path.join(b.dir,b.item.file))).mode&0o777,0o600);}finally{await b.close();}});
for(const kind of ['corrupted evidence','corrupted database','incomplete manifest','duplicate path','path traversal','wrong hash','wrong size','symlink'])test('backup verification rejects '+kind,async()=>{const b=await bundle();try{if(kind==='corrupted evidence')await writeFile(path.join(b.dir,b.item.file),'tampered');if(kind==='corrupted database')await writeFile(path.join(b.dir,'database.dump'),'tampered');if(kind==='incomplete manifest')b.manifest.complete=false;if(kind==='duplicate path')b.manifest.objects.push(b.item);if(kind==='path traversal')b.manifest.objects[0].file='../secret';if(kind==='wrong hash')b.manifest.database.sha256='0'.repeat(64);if(kind==='wrong size')b.manifest.database.size++;if(kind==='symlink'){await rm(path.join(b.dir,b.item.file));await symlink(path.join(b.dir,'database.dump'),path.join(b.dir,b.item.file));}await b.write();await assert.rejects(()=>verifyBundle(b.dir));}finally{await b.close();}});
test('backup refuses source integrity mismatch, missing versions and overwriting a copied object',async()=>{const b=await bundle();try{await assert.rejects(()=>saveBackupObject(b.dir,{get:async()=>Buffer.from('wrong')},b.row,1),/integrity|checksum/i);await assert.rejects(()=>saveBackupObject(b.dir,{}, {...b.row,object_version:null},1),/metadata/i);await assert.rejects(()=>saveBackupObject(b.dir,{get:async()=>b.original},b.row,0),e=>e.code==='EEXIST');assert.deepEqual(await readFile(path.join(b.dir,b.item.file)),b.original);}finally{await b.close();}});

function inventory(scope='SCOPE_1',extra={}){return {id:id(),ledger:'CORE',record_id:id(),activity_date:'2026-09-01',scope,category:'DIESEL',quantity:'1.000000',unit:'litre',kg_co2e:'0.100000',evidence_count:1,provenance:{method:'SYNTHETIC_TEST'},...extra};}

test('preview and publication require roles, status, exact size and matching SHA-256',async()=>{const f=fixture(),bytes=Buffer.from('synthetic bytes'),r=await f.s.insert('u_o_exports',{period_id:f.period,created_by:f.actors.ADMIN.id,status:'READY',format:'csv',byte_count:bytes.length,object_key:'test',object_version:'v',sha256:hash(bytes)}),storage={get:async()=>bytes};await denied(()=>downloadExport(f.s,storage,r.id),'APPROVAL_REQUIRED');await denied(()=>downloadExport(f.s.for(f.actors.LEADERSHIP),storage,r.id,{preview:true}),'FORBIDDEN');assert.equal((await downloadExport(f.s,storage,r.id,{preview:true})).bytes.toString(),bytes.toString());await denied(()=>downloadExport(f.s,{get:async()=>Buffer.from('tampered')},r.id,{preview:true}),'EXPORT_INTEGRITY');assert.equal(publicExport(r).object_key,undefined);});

async function harness(){const f=fixture(),logs=[],cache=new Map();const services={authenticate:async h=>{const user=f.actors[String(h).replace('Bearer ','')];if(!user)fail(401,'UNAUTHENTICATED','Fixture token required.');return user;},limit:async()=>{},operations:async r=>{const {route,params}=matchOperation(r.method,r.path);role(r.user,route.roles);fields(r.query,route.query);const run=()=>f.s.for(r.user).transaction(s=>route.fn(s,r.body,params,r.query,{cfg:f.cfg,storage:{}}));let result;if(r.method!=='GET'&&!route.secret){if(!r.key)fail(422,'IDEMPOTENCY_REQUIRED','Key required');const key=r.user.id+':'+r.path+':'+r.key,input=JSON.stringify(r.body),prior=cache.get(key);if(prior&&prior.input!==input)fail(409,'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT','New payload needs new key');result=prior?structuredClone(prior.result):await run();cache.set(key,{input,result:structuredClone(result)});}else result=await run();return route.file?{file:result}:{data:result};},account:async r=>{if(r.path.endsWith('/recover'))return requestReset(f.s,r.body,f.cfg);const encoded=await preparePassword(r.body);return f.s.transaction(s=>consumeLink(s,r.body,encoded));}};
 const cfg={production:false,origins:[],maxInflight:40,maxUploads:2,maxUploadBytes:10485760,metricsToken:'test',trustProxy:false};const app=createApp(cfg,services,{log:r=>logs.push(r)});app.server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(app.server,'listening');const base='http://127.0.0.1:'+app.server.address().port;cfg.origins.push(base);const request=async(path,{actor='ADMIN',body,headers={}}={})=>{const res=await fetch(base+path,{method:body===undefined?'GET':'POST',headers:{...(actor?{Authorization:'Bearer '+actor}:{}),...(body===undefined?{}:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Idempotency-Key':id()}),...headers},body:body===undefined?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)});const text=await res.text();let data;try{data=JSON.parse(text);}catch{}return {status:res.status,body:data,text,headers:res.headers};};return {...f,app,base,request,logs,close:()=>new Promise(resolve=>app.server.close(resolve))};}

/** Explicit test double. Does NOT execute PostgreSQL RLS, transactions, triggers or locks. */
import { MemoryStore, fixture as base } from '../university/memory-store.mjs';
import { id, fail, passwordHash } from '../../src/core.mjs';
import { canReadEvidence } from '../../src/operations/access.mjs';
import { operationsConfig, unseal } from '../../src/operations/crypto.mjs';
export const TEST_PASSWORD='Test-only-Password-12345';
const encoded=await passwordHash(TEST_PASSWORD);
export class OpsMemory extends MemoryStore {
 for(user){return new OpsMemory(this.state,user);}
 async maybe(table,rid,opts={}){const r=await super.maybe(table,rid,opts);if(table==='documents'&&r&&!canReadEvidence(this.user,r,{scope:(this.state.tables.u_o_document_scopes||[]).find(x=>x.document_id===rid),memberships:this.state.tables.u_o_memberships||[],grants:this.state.tables.u_o_document_grants||[]}))fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Document not found.');return r;}
 async account(email){return structuredClone((this.state.tables.users||[]).find(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.email===email)||null);}
 async accountById(id){return super.maybe('users',id);}
 async activeTenant(){return this.state.tables.tenants.some(t=>t.id===this.tenant&&t.status==='ACTIVE');}
 async tokenById(rid){return super.maybe('u_o_credentials',rid);}
 async credential(row){this.state.tables.u_o_credentials??=[];this.state.tables.u_o_credentials.push({...structuredClone(row),created_at:new Date().toISOString(),revoked_at:null,consumed_at:null});return row;}
 async revokeCredentials(email){for(const r of this.state.tables.u_o_credentials||[])if(r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.email===email&&!r.consumed_at&&!r.revoked_at)r.revoked_at=new Date().toISOString();}
 async consumeCredential(rid){const r=this.state.tables.u_o_credentials.find(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.id===rid);r.consumed_at=new Date().toISOString();}
 async revokeCredential(rid){const r=(this.state.tables.u_o_credentials||[]).find(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.id===rid&&!r.consumed_at);if(!r)fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Invitation not found');r.revoked_at=new Date().toISOString();}
 async createInvitedAccount(row,password_hash){const uid=id();this.state.tables.users.push({id:uid,tenant_id:this.tenant,name:row.name,email:row.email,role:row.role,password_hash,active:true,email_verified_at:new Date().toISOString()});return uid;}
 async setAccountPassword(uid,password_hash){const r=this.state.tables.users.find(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.id===uid);r.password_hash=password_hash;r.email_verified_at=new Date().toISOString();this.state.sessions=this.state.sessions.filter(x=>x.user_id!==uid||x.tenant_id!==this.tenant);}
 async enqueueMail(row){this.state.tables.u_o_mail??=[];if(!this.state.tables.u_o_mail.some(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.dedupe_key===row.dedupe_key)){this.state.tables.u_o_mail.push({...structuredClone(row),status:'PENDING'});await this.enqueue('SEND_MAIL',row.id);}return row.id;}
 async enqueue(kind,entityId){if(!this.state.jobs.some(j=>j.tenant_id===this.tenant&&j.kind===kind&&j.entity_id===entityId))this.state.jobs.push({id:id(),tenant_id:this.tenant,kind,entity_id:entityId,status:'QUEUED'});}
 async transferSource(rid,owner,expected){const r=this.state.tables.u_c_sources.find(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.id===rid);if(!r||r.ownership_version!==expected)fail(409,'STALE_VERSION','Ownership changed');r.owner_id=owner;r.ownership_version++;return structuredClone(r);}
 async notify(userId,kind,entityId,title,message,dedupeKey){if(!(this.state.tables.u_o_notifications||[]).some(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.user_id===userId&&r.dedupe_key===dedupeKey))await this.insert('u_o_notifications',{user_id:userId,kind,entity_id:entityId,title,message,dedupe_key:dedupeKey,read_at:null});}
}
export function fixture(){const f=base();f.state.sessions=[];f.state.jobs=[];for(const u of f.state.tables.users)u.password_hash=encoded;f.document.version=1;f.document.extraction={kind:'INVOICE',pages:[{page:1,text:''}]};Object.assign(f.state.tables.documents[0],f.document);f.s=new OpsMemory(f.state,f.actors.ADMIN);f.cfg=operationsConfig({MAIL_MODE:'capture',MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY:'a'.repeat(64),PUBLIC_BASE_URL:'http://localhost:8080',OCR_ENABLED:'true'});return f;}
export function mailedToken(f,index=-1){const m=f.state.tables.u_o_mail.at(index),text=unseal(m.envelope,f.cfg.encryptionKey,`${f.tenant}:${m.id}`).text;return decodeURIComponent(text.match(/#token=([^\s]+)/)[1]);}

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {operationsTx} from '../../src/operations/routes.mjs';import {id} from '../../src/core.mjs';
function adapter({tenant='ACTIVE',active=true,role='ADMIN'}={}){const queries=[],c={release(){},async query(sql){queries.push(sql);if(sql.startsWith('SELECT status FROM cs.tenants'))return {rows:[{status:tenant}]};if(sql.startsWith('SELECT * FROM cs.users'))return {rows:[{active,role}]};return {rows:[]};}};return {queries,pool:{connect:async()=>c},user:{id:id(),tenant_id:id(),role:'ADMIN'}};}
for(const mode of ['suspended university','inactive account','changed role'])test('operations transaction rejects '+mode+' before executing a mutation',async()=>{const f=adapter(mode==='suspended university'?{tenant:'SUSPENDED'}:mode==='inactive account'?{active:false}:{role:'ENTRY'});let ran=false;await assert.rejects(()=>operationsTx(f.pool,f.user,async()=>{ran=true;}),e=>e.code==='UNAUTHENTICATED');assert.equal(ran,false);assert.ok(f.queries.includes('ROLLBACK'));});
test('operations reauthorization locks tenant before actor and commits successful work',async()=>{const f=adapter();assert.equal(await operationsTx(f.pool,f.user,async()=>17),17);const t=f.queries.findIndex(q=>q.includes('FROM cs.tenants')),u=f.queries.findIndex(q=>q.includes('FROM cs.users'));assert.ok(t>=0&&u>t);assert.match(f.queries[t],/FOR SHARE/);assert.match(f.queries[u],/FOR UPDATE/);assert.ok(f.queries.includes('COMMIT'));});
