```javascript
import { inventorySummary,metricSummary,intensities,coverage } from '../../src/university/reporting.mjs';
import { factorBody,fixture,emissionBody } from './memory-store.mjs';
const throws=(fn,code)=>assert.throws(fn,e=>e.code===code);
test('university catalog includes 15 explicit Scope 3 screening categories',()=>assert.equal(c.SCOPE3_CATEGORIES.length,15));
test('student commuting is supplemental, not silently employee category 7',()=>{assert.equal(c.CATEGORIES.STUDENT_COMMUTING.scope,'SUPPLEMENTAL');assert.equal(c.CATEGORIES.STUDENT_COMMUTING.number,null);assert.equal(c.CATEGORIES.EMPLOYEE_COMMUTING.number,7);});
test('university templates include water, lab waste, dining, academic and normalization metrics',()=>{for(const code of ['WATER_WITHDRAWAL_M3','LAB_HAZARDOUS_WASTE_KG','FOOD_WASTE_KG','SUSTAINABILITY_COURSES','STUDENT_FTE'])assert.ok(c.KPI_TEMPLATES.some(k=>k.code===code));});
test('physical factor normalizes exact decimals without assigning official provenance',()=>{const r=c.factorInput(factorBody);assert.equal(r.value,'1.500000000');assert.equal(r.currency,null);assert.match(r.source,/SYNTHETIC/);});
test('spend-based factor requires currency and base price year',()=>{throws(()=>c.factorInput({...factorBody,unit:'INR',method:'SPEND_BASED'}),'INVALID_CHOICE');const f=c.factorInput({...factorBody,unit:'INR',method:'SPEND_BASED',currency:'INR',priceYear:2025});assert.equal(f.price_year,2025);});
test('physical factors reject money-method mismatch',()=>throws(()=>c.factorInput({...factorBody,method:'SPEND_BASED'}),'METHOD_UNIT'));
test('factor sources must be HTTPS without embedded credentials',()=>{for(const sourceUrl of ['http://example.com','https://u:p@example.com','javascript:alert(1)'])throws(()=>c.factorInput({...factorBody,sourceUrl}),'SOURCE_URL');});
test('factors reject backward validity dates',()=>throws(()=>c.factorInput({...factorBody,validTo:'2025-01-01'}),'DATE_RANGE'));
test('factor zero is not fabricated as a clean-energy default',()=>throws(()=>c.factorInput({...factorBody,value:'0'}),'INVALID_DECIMAL'));
test('emission input uses exact quantity and server-derived scope',()=>{const f=fixture(),a=c.emissionInput(emissionBody(f,id()));assert.equal(a.scope,'SCOPE_3');assert.equal(a.scope3_category,1);assert.equal(a.quantity,'100.000000');});
for(const quantity of [100,'-1','1e3','NaN','1.0000001','0','1000000000000'])test('reject invalid input quantity '+String(quantity),()=>{const f=fixture();throws(()=>c.emissionInput(emissionBody(f,id(),{quantity})),'INVALID_DECIMAL');});
test('tenant, scope, approval and computed values cannot be supplied by caller',()=>{const f=fixture();for(const bad of ['tenantId','scope','kgCo2e','approved_by'])throws(()=>c.emissionInput({...emissionBody(f,id()),[bad]:'injected'}),'UNKNOWN_FIELD');});
test('unapproved factor or unit mismatch blocks calculation',()=>{const f=fixture(),a=c.emissionInput(emissionBody(f,id())),factor={...c.factorInput(factorBody),status:'DRAFT'};throws(()=>c.checkFactor(a,factor),'FACTOR_MISMATCH');throws(()=>c.checkFactor(a,{...factor,status:'APPROVED',unit:'item'}),'FACTOR_MISMATCH');});
test('spend quantity and factor must have exactly the same price basis',()=>{const f=fixture(),a=c.emissionInput(emissionBody(f,id(),{unit:'INR',currency:'INR',priceYear:2026,dataQuality:'SPEND_PROXY',assumptions:'Synthetic spending method, assumptions explicitly recorded'}));const factor={...c.factorInput({...factorBody,unit:'INR',method:'SPEND_BASED',currency:'INR',priceYear:2025}),status:'APPROVED'};throws(()=>c.checkFactor(a,factor),'PRICE_BASIS_MISMATCH');});
test('estimates require a substantive assumptions note',()=>{const f=fixture();throws(()=>c.emissionInput(emissionBody(f,id(),{dataQuality:'ESTIMATED'})),'INVALID_FIELD');});
test('PCF-only factor categories cannot enter university inventory',()=>{const f=fixture();throws(()=>c.emissionInput(emissionBody(f,id(),{category:'PCF_ENERGY',unit:'kWh'})),'FACTOR_ONLY_CATEGORY');});
test('decimal multiplication is exact and half-up at micro-kg precision',()=>{assert.equal(c.product('0.1','0.2'),'0.020000');assert.equal(c.product('1','0.0000005'),'0.000001');assert.equal(c.product('0','1'),'0.000000');});
test('large sums are not limited by JavaScript Number precision',()=>assert.equal(c.sum(['999999999999.999999','0.000001']),'1000000000000.000000'));
test('zero denominator returns null rather than misleading zero intensity',()=>{assert.equal(c.ratio('100','0'),null);assert.equal(c.ratio('1','3'),'0.333333');});
test('signed observed changes preserve negative reduction percentages',()=>assert.equal(c.percentOf('-10','100'),'-10.00'));
const commute={oneWayKm:'10',days:200,participants:10,mode:'bus',basis:'passenger_km',sampleSize:10,population:100,extrapolate:false};
test('commuting distance includes explicit round-trip days and sampled participants',()=>assert.equal(c.commutingEstimate(commute).quantity,'40000.000000'));
test('commuting extrapolation is an explicit estimated operation',()=>{const r=c.commutingEstimate({...commute,extrapolate:true});assert.equal(r.quantity,'400000.000000');assert.equal(r.estimated,true);assert.equal(r.coveragePercent,'10.00');});
test('vehicle-km divides by occupancy, passenger-km must not do so',()=>{assert.equal(c.commutingEstimate({...commute,basis:'vehicle_km',occupancy:'2'}).quantity,'20000.000000');throws(()=>c.commutingEstimate({...commute,occupancy:'2'}),'OCCUPANCY');});
test('commuting sampling and occupants are validated',()=>{throws(()=>c.commutingEstimate({...commute,participants:9}),'SAMPLE_SIZE');throws(()=>c.commutingEstimate({...commute,basis:'vehicle_km',occupancy:'0.5'}),'OCCUPANCY');});
test('CSV parser handles quoted comma, doubled quote and newline',()=>{assert.deepEqual(c.csvParse('a,b\r\n"x,y","a""b\nc"\r\n'),[{a:'x,y',b:'a"b\nc'}]);});
for(const bad of ['a,a\n1,2','a,b\n1','a\n"unclosed','a\n"x"y','a\nx"y'])test('reject malformed CSV '+JSON.stringify(bad),()=>assert.throws(()=>c.csvParse(bad),e=>e.status===422));
test('CSV row and byte limits are explicit',()=>{throws(()=>c.csvParse('a\n1\n2',{maxRows:1}),'CSV_ROWS');throws(()=>c.csvParse('a\n'+ 'x'.repeat(50100)),'CSV_LIMIT');});
test('CSV export neutralizes formula prefixes, including leading whitespace',()=>{for(const v of ['=cmd',' +cmd','-1+2','@x','\txyz'])assert.match(c.csvCell(v),/^"'/);assert.equal(c.csvCell('42'),'"42"');});
test('HTML exports escape active markup',()=>assert.equal(c.htmlEscape('<img src=x onerror="x">'),'&lt;img src=x onerror=&quot;x&quot;&gt;'));
const questions=[{key:'QTY',label:'Annual water',type:'NUMBER',required:true,unit:'m3'},{key:'PLAN',label:'Plan',type:'CHOICE',required:false,options:['Yes','No']}];
test('supplier questionnaires validate answer types and missing fields',()=>{const q=c.questionnaire(questions);assert.deepEqual(c.validateAnswers(q,{QTY:'1.2'}),{QTY:'1.200000'});throws(()=>c.validateAnswers(q,{}),'MISSING_ANSWER');throws(()=>c.validateAnswers(q,{QTY:100}),'INVALID_DECIMAL');throws(()=>c.validateAnswers(q,{QTY:'1',PLAN:'Maybe'}),'INVALID_CHOICE');});
test('supplier questionnaires reject repeated keys and unknown answer fields',()=>{throws(()=>c.questionnaire([questions[0],questions[0]]),'DUPLICATE_KEY');throws(()=>c.validateAnswers(c.questionnaire(questions),{QTY:'1',secret:'x'}),'UNKNOWN_FIELD');});
const assessment={topics:[{code:'WATER',label:'Water'}],min_responses:5,impact_threshold:'3.00',financial_threshold:'4.00'};
test('materiality responses below privacy threshold are suppressed',()=>{const r=c.materialitySummary(assessment,[{scores:[{topic:'WATER',impact:5,financial:5}],stakeholder_group:'STUDENTS'}]);assert.equal(r.suppressed,true);assert.deepEqual(r.topics,[]);});
test('materiality flags both axes while suppressing small stakeholder groups',()=>{const responses=Array.from({length:5},(_,i)=>({scores:[{topic:'WATER',impact:4,financial:2,rationale:'private'}],stakeholder_group:i?'STAFF':'STUDENTS'}));const r=c.materialitySummary(assessment,responses);assert.equal(r.topics[0].impact,'4.00');assert.equal(r.topics[0].impactFlag,true);assert.equal(r.topics[0].financialFlag,false);assert.ok(r.groups.every(g=>g.suppressed));assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(r).includes('private'));});
test('materiality must score each topic once with bounded whole-number ratings',()=>{throws(()=>c.validateScores(assessment.topics,[]),'INCOMPLETE_SURVEY');throws(()=>c.validateScores(assessment.topics,[{topic:'WATER',impact:6,financial:3}]),'INVALID_INTEGER');});
test('primary inventory excludes supplemental student emissions',()=>{const r=inventorySummary([{scope:'SCOPE_2',category:'ELECTRICITY',campus_id:'a',kg_co2e:'10.000000',evidence_count:1},{scope:'SUPPLEMENTAL',category:'STUDENT_COMMUTING',campus_id:'a',kg_co2e:'900.000000',evidence_count:1}]);assert.equal(r.totalKgCo2e,'10.000000');assert.equal(r.scopes.SUPPLEMENTAL,'900.000000');assert.equal(r.recordCount,1);});
test('latest approved KPI revision replaces prior value without double counting',()=>{const base={kpi_id:'k',task_id:'t',campus_id:'a',bucket:'METER',kpi_code:'WATER',unit:'m3',aggregation:'SUM',interval_end:'2026-05-31',evidence:[]};const r=metricSummary([{...base,id:'old',revision:1,value:'10.000000'},{...base,id:'new',revision:2,value:'12.000000'}]);assert.equal(r[0].value,'12.000000');assert.deepEqual(r[0].sourceSnapshotIds,['new']);});
test('point-in-time headcounts are not added across collection intervals',()=>{const base={kpi_id:'k',campus_id:'a',bucket:'CAMPUS_TOTAL',kpi_code:'STUDENT_FTE',unit:'FTE',aggregation:'LATEST',revision:1,evidence:[]};const r=metricSummary([{...base,id:'x',task_id:'t1',interval_end:'2026-04-30',value:'100.000000'},{...base,id:'y',task_id:'t2',interval_end:'2026-05-31',value:'110.000000'}]);assert.equal(r[0].value,'110.000000');});
test('percent observations have no mathematically invalid summed total',()=>{const r=metricSummary([{id:'a',kpi_id:'k',task_id:'t',campus_id:'c',bucket:'b',kpi_code:'RATIO',unit:'percent',aggregation:'LATEST',revision:1,value:'80.000000',interval_end:'2026-04-30'}]);assert.equal(r[0].value,null);});
test('missing campus denominator blocks apparently precise intensity',()=>{const r=intensities({campuses:[{campusId:'a'},{campusId:'b'}],totalKgCo2e:'100.000000'},[{code:'STUDENT_FTE',byCampus:[{campusId:'a',value:'10.000000'}]}]);assert.equal(r[0].kgCo2ePerUnit,null);assert.deepEqual(r[0].missingCampusIds,['b']);});
test('Scope 3 coverage keeps unassessed categories visible',()=>{const r=coverage([{category_number:1,decision:'INCLUDED',rationale:'Declared'}],[]);assert.equal(r.length,15);assert.ok(r[0].warning);assert.equal(r[14].decision,'NOT_ASSESSED');});
test('PCF allocation and functional-unit normalization are explicit and inventory-excluded',()=>{const fid=id(),study=c.pcfInput({name:'Test meal',functionalUnit:'one meal',outputQuantity:'10',boundary:'Synthetic screening boundary only',studyDate:'2026-06-01',bom:[{name:'Food',stage:'MATERIALS',quantity:'10',unit:'kg',factorId:fid,allocationPercent:'50'}]});const f={...c.factorInput(factorBody),id:fid,status:'APPROVED'},r=c.calculatePcf(study,[f]);assert.equal(r.totalKgCo2e,'7.500000');assert.equal(r.perFunctionalUnitKgCo2e,'0.750000');assert.equal(r.inventoryIncluded,false);assert.ok(r.missingStages.includes('USE'));});
test('PCF refuses spend proxies, missing factors and over-allocation',()=>{const fid=id(),b={name:'Test',functionalUnit:'one',outputQuantity:'1',boundary:'Test screening boundary',studyDate:'2026-06-01',bom:[{name:'Material',stage:'MATERIALS',quantity:'1',unit:'kg',factorId:fid,allocationPercent:'101'}]};throws(()=>c.pcfInput(b),'ALLOCATION');b.bom[0].allocationPercent='100';throws(()=>c.calculatePcf(c.pcfInput(b),[]),'PCF_FACTOR');});
```

```javascript
/** Domain workflow tests use a clearly labelled in-memory repository, not a PostgreSQL emulator. */
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { id } from '../../src/core.mjs';
import * as collect from '../../src/university/collection.mjs';
import * as emit from '../../src/university/emissions.mjs';
import * as collab from '../../src/university/collaboration.mjs';
import * as reports from '../../src/university/reporting.mjs';
import * as plan from '../../src/university/planning.mjs';
import { csvWrite,hash } from '../../src/university/core.mjs';
import { fixture,factorBody,emissionBody } from './memory-store.mjs';
const reject=(fn,code)=>assert.rejects(fn,e=>e.code===code);
async function approvedFactor(f,extra={}){let r=await emit.createFactor(f.s,{...factorBody,...extra});r=await emit.approveFactor(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),r.id,{version:r.version});return r;}
async function screened(f,n=1){return emit.setScreening(f.s,{periodId:f.period,categoryNumber:n,decision:'INCLUDED',rationale:'Explicit synthetic test boundary, not actual university data'});}
async function calculated(f,extra={}){const factor=await approvedFactor(f,{...(extra.category?{category:extra.category}:{}),...(extra.unit?{unit:extra.unit}:{}),versionLabel:'TEST-'+id()});if(factor.category==='PURCHASED_GOODS')await screened(f).catch(e=>{if(e.code!=='STALE_VERSION')throw e;});let e=await emit.createEmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),emissionBody(f,factor.id,extra));e=await emit.emissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),e.id,'submit',{version:e.version});e=await emit.emissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),e.id,'approve',{version:e.version});return e;}
async function waterTask(f,extra={}){let k=(await f.s.rows('u_kpis',{code:'WATER_WITHDRAWAL_M3'}))[0];if(!k){await collect.installCatalog(f.s,{});k=(await f.s.rows('u_kpis',{code:'WATER_WITHDRAWAL_M3'}))[0];}return collect.createTask(f.s,{periodId:f.period,campusId:f.campus,kpiId:k.id,assigneeId:f.actors.ENTRY.id,reviewerId:f.actors.REVIEWER.id,bucket:'METER_A',intervalStart:'2026-04-01',intervalEnd:'2026-04-30',dueDate:'2026-05-10',...extra});}
async function approveMetric(f,t,value='12'){let sub=await collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:t.version,value,unit:'m3',evidenceIds:[f.document.id]});sub=await collect.submissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),sub.id,'submit',{version:sub.version});return collect.submissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),sub.id,'approve',{version:sub.version});}
function lockPeriod(f){const p=f.state.tables.periods.find(p=>p.id===f.period);p.status='LOCKED';p.version++;}
async function approvedReport(f,title='Test baseline'){lockPeriod(f);let r=await reports.createReport(f.s,{periodId:f.period,title,purpose:'UNIVERSITY_SUSTAINABILITY',boundaryStatement:'Same synthetic test university operational boundary'});return reports.reviewReport(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),r.id,'approve',{version:r.version});}
test('installing university catalog is repeatable and never seeds measurements or factors',async()=>{const f=fixture();const a=await collect.installCatalog(f.s,{}),b=await collect.installCatalog(f.s,{});assert.equal(a.added,22);assert.equal(b.added,0);assert.equal(await f.s.count('u_submissions'),0);assert.equal(await f.s.count('u_factors'),0);});
test('department cannot reference another university campus',async()=>{const f=fixture();await reject(()=>collect.createDepartment(f.s,{campusId:id(),name:'Lab',code:'LAB',ownerId:f.actors.ENTRY.id}),'NOT_FOUND');});
test('collection rejects overlapping intervals for the same KPI source',async()=>{const f=fixture();await waterTask(f);await reject(()=>waterTask(f,{intervalStart:'2026-04-15',intervalEnd:'2026-05-15',dueDate:'2026-05-20'}),'OVERLAPPING_TASK');assert.ok(f.state.locks.length>=2);});
test('normalization task must use one whole-period campus-wide bucket',async()=>{const f=fixture();await collect.installCatalog(f.s,{});const k=(await f.s.rows('u_kpis',{code:'STUDENT_FTE'}))[0];await reject(()=>waterTask(f,{kpiId:k.id}),'NORMALIZATION_BOUNDARY');});
test('data-entry users cannot read or write another assignee task',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f);await reject(()=>collect.getTask(f.s.for(f.actors.OTHER_ENTRY),t.id),'NOT_FOUND');await reject(()=>collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.OTHER_ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:t.version,value:'1',unit:'m3'}),'NOT_FOUND');});
test('KPI approval creates a snapshot and completes the task',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f),sub=await approveMetric(f,t);assert.equal(sub.status,'APPROVED');assert.equal((await f.s.get('u_tasks',t.id)).status,'COMPLETE');assert.equal((await f.s.metricRows(f.period))[0].value,'12.000000');});
test('KPI cannot be submitted without required clean evidence',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f),sub=await collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:t.version,value:'1',unit:'m3'});await reject(()=>collect.submissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),sub.id,'submit',{version:sub.version}),'EVIDENCE_REQUIRED');});
test('quarantined document cannot be used as evidence',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f);f.state.tables.documents[0].scan_result='INFECTED';await reject(()=>collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:t.version,value:'1',unit:'m3',evidenceIds:[f.document.id]}),'EVIDENCE_NOT_READY');});
test('another administrator may not edit an author draft and then approve it',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f),sub=await collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:t.version,value:'1',unit:'m3'});await reject(()=>collect.editSubmission(f.s,sub.id,{version:sub.version,value:'2',unit:'m3'}),'AUTHOR_REQUIRED');});
test('maker-checker prevents self-approval even after elevation to administrator',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f);let sub=await collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:t.version,value:'1',unit:'m3',evidenceIds:[f.document.id]});sub=await collect.submissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),sub.id,'submit',{version:sub.version});await reject(()=>collect.submissionAction(f.s.for({...f.actors.ENTRY,role:'ADMIN'}),sub.id,'approve',{version:sub.version}),'SELF_APPROVAL');});
test('KPI correction preserves old snapshot and counts only the latest approved revision',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f);await approveMetric(f,t,'10');const current=await f.s.get('u_tasks',t.id);let sub=await collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),t.id,{taskVersion:current.version,value:'15',unit:'m3',evidenceIds:[f.document.id],correctionReason:'Meter transcription corrected against actual evidence'});sub=await collect.submissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),sub.id,'submit',{version:sub.version});await collect.submissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),sub.id,'approve',{version:sub.version});assert.equal(await f.s.count('u_metric_snapshots'),2);assert.equal(reports.metricSummary(await f.s.metricRows(f.period))[0].value,'15.000000');});
test('KPI waiver records a reason and cannot hide already approved data',async()=>{const f=fixture(),t=await waterTask(f);const r=await collect.waiveTask(f.s,t.id,{version:t.version,reason:'Meter not commissioned during the reporting interval'});assert.equal(r.status,'WAIVED');await reject(()=>collect.createSubmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),r.id,{taskVersion:r.version,value:'1',unit:'m3'}),'TASK_WAIVED');});
test('factor author cannot approve their own factor',async()=>{const f=fixture(),r=await emit.createFactor(f.s,factorBody);await reject(()=>emit.approveFactor(f.s,r.id,{version:r.version}),'SELF_APPROVAL');});
test('Scope 3 approval requires declared included category and evidence',async()=>{const f=fixture(),factor=await approvedFactor(f);let e=await emit.createEmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),emissionBody(f,factor.id));e=await emit.emissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),e.id,'submit',{version:e.version});await reject(()=>emit.emissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),e.id,'approve',{version:e.version}),'SCOPE3_SCREENING');});
test('calculated emission retains exact factor provenance and evidence hash',async()=>{const f=fixture(),e=await calculated(f);assert.equal(e.calculation.kg_co2e,'150.000000');assert.equal(e.calculation.provenance.evidence[0].sha256,'a'.repeat(64));assert.match(e.calculation.provenance.factor.source,/SYNTHETIC/);});
test('repeat approval cannot create a second calculation',async()=>{const f=fixture(),e=await calculated(f);await reject(()=>emit.emissionAction(f.s.for(f.actors.REVIEWER),e.id,'approve',{version:e.version}),'INVALID_STATE');assert.equal(await f.s.count('u_calculations'),1);});
test('a category with calculated emissions cannot be excluded',async()=>{const f=fixture();await calculated(f);const old=(await f.s.rows('u_scope3_screenings'))[0];await reject(()=>emit.setScreening(f.s,{periodId:f.period,categoryNumber:1,decision:'EXCLUDED',rationale:'Trying to hide already recorded emissions',version:old.version}),'CATEGORY_HAS_CALCULATIONS');});
test('data-entry emission read is author-scoped',async()=>{const f=fixture(),e=await calculated(f);await reject(()=>emit.getEmission(f.s.for(f.actors.OTHER_ENTRY),e.id),'NOT_FOUND');});
test('locked periods reject new university activity records',async()=>{const f=fixture(),factor=await approvedFactor(f);lockPeriod(f);await reject(()=>emit.createEmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),emissionBody(f,factor.id)),'PERIOD_LOCKED');});

test('replacement activity requires an approved void',async()=>{const f=fixture(),e=await calculated(f);await reject(()=>emit.createEmission(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),emissionBody(f,e.factor_id,{replacesId:e.id})),'VOID_REQUIRED');});
test('CSV preview validates fields and references without adding records',async()=>{const f=fixture(),factor=await approvedFactor(f),b=emissionBody(f,factor.id),header=Object.keys(b),csv=csvWrite(header,[header.map(k=>k==='evidenceIds'?b[k].join('|'):b[k])]);const r=await emit.importEmissions(f.s.for(f.actors.ENTRY),{csv});assert.equal(r.valid,true);assert.equal(await f.s.count('u_emissions'),0);});
```

## scale-api/tests/university/memory-store.mjs

```javascript
/** Test double only. This exercises domain behavior, NOT PostgreSQL, RLS, locks or migrations. */
import { id, fail } from '../../src/core.mjs';
import { UniversityStore, TABLES } from '../../src/university/store.mjs';
import { inventorySummary } from '../../src/university/reporting.mjs';
import { sum } from '../../src/university/core.mjs';
const copy=x=>structuredClone(x);
export class MemoryStore {
  constructor(state,user){this.state=state;this.user=user;this.tenant=user.tenant_id;}
  for(user){return new MemoryStore(this.state,user);}
  async lockKey(key){this.state.locks.push(key);}
  async maybe(table,rid){const r=this.state.tables[table]?.find(r=>r.id===rid&&(table==='tenants'?r.id===this.tenant:r.tenant_id===this.tenant));return r?copy(r):null;}
  async get(table,rid){const r=await this.maybe(table,rid);if(!r)fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Record not found.');return r;}
  async rows(table,filters={},limit=1000){const rows=(this.state.tables[table]||[]).filter(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&Object.entries(filters).every(([k,v])=>Array.isArray(v)?v.includes(r[k]):r[k]===v));if(rows.length>limit)fail(422,'RESULT_LIMIT','Test fixture result cap');return copy(rows);}
  async count(table,filters={}){return (await this.rows(table,filters,10000)).length;}
  async listPage(table,filters={},q={}){const items=await this.rows(table,filters,10000);return {items:items.slice(0,Number(q.limit||50)),nextCursor:null};}
  async insert(table,data){const defaults={u_tasks:'OPEN',u_submissions:'DRAFT',u_factors:'DRAFT',u_emissions:'DRAFT',u_voids:'SUBMITTED',u_supplier_requests:'DRAFT',u_materiality:'OPEN',u_reports:'SUBMITTED',u_pcf_studies:'DRAFT',u_initiatives:'PLANNED'};
    const r={id:id(),tenant_id:this.tenant,created_at:new Date().toISOString(),...(TABLES[table]?.includes('version')?{version:1}:{}),...(defaults[table]?{status:defaults[table]}:{}),...copy(data)};
    if(r.tenant_id!==this.tenant)fail(403,'FORBIDDEN','Tenant mismatch');if(table==='u_invites')Object.assign(r,{revoked:false,consumed:false,...r});
    if(table==='u_tasks')r.waiver_reason??=null;if(table==='u_submissions'){r.approved_by??=null;r.rejection_reason??=null;}
    if(table==='u_supplier_requests'){r.answers??=null;r.evidence_ids??=[];}
    const rows=this.state.tables[table]||=[];
    if(table==='u_emissions'&&rows.some(x=>x.tenant_id===this.tenant&&x.external_key===r.external_key))fail(409,'CONFLICT','Duplicate source key');
    rows.push(r);return copy(r);}
  async update(table,rid,data){const rows=this.state.tables[table]||[],i=rows.findIndex(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.id===rid);if(i<0)fail(404,'NOT_FOUND','Record not found.');const old=rows[i];rows[i]={...old,...copy(data),...(old.version?{version:old.version+1}:{})};return copy(rows[i]);}
  async period(rid,write=true){const p=await this.get('periods',rid);if(write&&p.status!=='OPEN')fail(409,'PERIOD_LOCKED','Reporting period is locked.');return p;}
  async userRef(...args){return UniversityStore.prototype.userRef.apply(this,args);}
  async location(...args){return UniversityStore.prototype.location.apply(this,args);}
  async evidence(...args){return UniversityStore.prototype.evidence.apply(this,args);}
  async audit(action,rid,details={}){this.state.audit.push({action,rid,userId:this.user.id,details:copy(details)});}
  async inventory(pid){const rows=copy(this.state.coreInventory.filter(r=>r.tenant_id===this.tenant&&r.period_id===pid));for(const e of await this.rows('u_emissions',{period_id:pid,status:'CALCULATED'},10000)){if(await this.count('u_voids',{emission_id:e.id,status:'APPROVED'}))continue;const c=(await this.rows('u_calculations',{emission_id:e.id},1))[0];if(c)rows.push({...c,record_id:e.id,period_id:pid,campus_id:e.campus_id,activity_date:e.activity_date,category:e.category,scope:e.scope,scope3_category:e.scope3_category,quantity:e.quantity,unit:e.unit,data_quality:e.data_quality,ledger:'UNIVERSITY',evidence_count:e.evidence_ids.length});}return rows;}
  async inventoryTotals(pid){return (await this.inventory(pid)).map(r=>({...r,records:1,evidence_records:r.evidence_count>0?1:0}));}
  async metricRows(pid){const all=await this.rows('u_metric_snapshots',{period_id:pid},10000);return all.filter(r=>!all.some(n=>n.task_id===r.task_id&&n.revision>r.revision));}
  async missingTasks(pid){const tasks=await this.rows('u_tasks',{period_id:pid,status:'OPEN'},10000);return tasks.map(t=>({...t,overdue:t.due_date<new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}));}
  async transaction(fn){const snap=copy(this.state);try{return await fn(this);}catch(e){Object.assign(this.state,snap);throw e;}}
}
export function fixture(){const tenant=id(),campus=id(),period=id(),state={tables:{},audit:[],locks:[],coreInventory:[]},actors={};
  state.tables.tenants=[{id:tenant,name:'Synthetic Test University',status:'ACTIVE'}];state.tables.campuses=[{id:campus,tenant_id:tenant,name:'Synthetic campus',code:'TEST',created_at:new Date().toISOString()}];state.tables.periods=[{id:period,tenant_id:tenant,name:'Synthetic FY',start_date:'2026-04-01',end_date:'2027-03-31',status:'OPEN',version:1,created_at:new Date().toISOString()}];state.tables.users=[];
  for(const name of ['ADMIN','ENTRY','REVIEWER','LEADERSHIP','OTHER_ENTRY']){const a={id:id(),tenant_id:tenant,role:name==='OTHER_ENTRY'?'ENTRY':name,name,email:name.toLowerCase()+'@test.invalid',active:true};actors[name]=a;state.tables.users.push(a);}
  const document={id:id(),tenant_id:tenant,original_name:'synthetic-evidence.txt',mime_type:'text/plain',file_size:'100',sha256:'a'.repeat(64),object_version:'test-version-only',status:'REVIEW_REQUIRED',scan_result:'CLEAN',scan_engine:'CONTROLLED_TEST_DOUBLE',uploaded_by:actors.ENTRY.id};state.tables.documents=[document];const s=new MemoryStore(state,actors.ADMIN);
  return {s,state,actors,tenant,campus,period,document};}
export const factorBody={category:'PURCHASED_GOODS',unit:'kg',value:'1.5',method:'ACTIVITY_BASED',source:'SYNTHETIC TEST FACTOR - never use for real reporting',sourceUrl:'https://example.invalid/test-factor',region:'TEST',boundary:'Synthetic cradle-to-gate test-only boundary',versionLabel:'TEST-v1',validFrom:'2026-04-01',validTo:'2027-03-31'};
export function emissionBody(f,factorId,extra={}){return {periodId:f.period,campusId:f.campus,category:'PURCHASED_GOODS',unit:'kg',quantity:'100',activityDate:'2026-06-01',externalKey:'test:'+id(),description:'Synthetic purchased goods quantity',factorId,dataQuality:'MEASURED',evidenceIds:[f.document.id],...extra};}
```

```javascript
/** Actual PostgreSQL acceptance tests. NOT part of unit-test results.
 * Only a disposable database with a name ending in _test is accepted.
 * Creates unique fixture tenants; never wipes a database. Document metadata is a
 * controlled fixture, NOT a claim that an actual file was scanned or downloaded.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {migrate} from '../../scripts/migrate.mjs';
import {createPool,tenantTx,assertRuntimeRole} from '../../src/db.mjs';
import {id,hash,passwordHash} from '../../src/core.mjs';
import {setPeriod} from '../../src/management.mjs';
import {dispatch,portalDispatch} from '../../src/university/router.mjs';
const ownerUrl=process.env.TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL;
if(!ownerUrl||!new URL(ownerUrl).pathname.endsWith('_test'))throw Error('TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL must name a disposable PostgreSQL database ending in _test. No database integration tests ran.');
const apiPass=process.env.TEST_API_PASSWORD||'only-test-api-password-32-characters',workerPass=process.env.TEST_WORKER_PASSWORD||'only-test-worker-password-32-characters';
process.env.REQUEST_HASH_SECRET='university-integration-only-request-hash-not-production';
await migrate(ownerUrl,{apiPassword:apiPass,workerPassword:workerPass});
const {Client}=await import('pg'),owner=new Client({connectionString:ownerUrl});await owner.connect();
const url=role=>{const u=new URL(ownerUrl);u.username=role;u.password=role==='cs_api'?apiPass:workerPass;return u.href;};
const pool=await createPool({databaseUrl:url('cs_api'),ssl:false,poolMax:10}),worker=await createPool({databaseUrl:url('cs_worker'),ssl:false,poolMax:2});
let count=0;const check=async(name,fn)=>{await fn();count++;console.log('PASS '+name);};
```

## scale-api/tests/university/store.test.mjs

```javascript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { id } from '../../src/core.mjs';
import { UniversityStore,universityTx } from '../../src/university/store.mjs';
import { migrationPlan } from '../../scripts/migrate.mjs';
const user={id:id(),tenant_id:id(),role:'ADMIN'};
function client(){const calls=[];return {calls,async query(sql,params=[]){calls.push({sql,params});if(sql.startsWith('SELECT count'))return {rows:[{n:'0'}]};return {rows:[]};},release(broken){calls.push({release:true,broken});}};}
test('repository includes explicit tenant predicate and uses parameters for record IDs',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user),rid=id();await s.maybe('u_emissions',rid);assert.match(c.calls[0].sql,/tenant_id=\$1 AND id=\$2/);assert.deepEqual(c.calls[0].params,[user.tenant_id,rid]);});
test('repository rejects unknown table identifiers rather than interpolating them',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user);await assert.rejects(()=>s.rows('u_emissions; DROP SCHEMA cs',{}),/allowlist/);assert.equal(c.calls.length,0);});
test('repository rejects untrusted column identifiers',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user);await assert.rejects(()=>s.rows('u_emissions',{'status OR true':'x'}),/allowlist/);assert.equal(c.calls.length,0);});
test('SQL values such as descriptions are parameterized',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user),payload="x' OR true --";await s.rows('u_emissions',{description:payload});assert.ok(!c.calls[0].sql.includes(payload));assert.ok(c.calls[0].params.includes(payload));});
test('repository write serializes evidence IDs as JSON, not a PostgreSQL text array',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user),eid=id();await s.insert('u_emissions',{evidence_ids:[eid],created_by:user.id});assert.ok(c.calls[0].params.includes(JSON.stringify([eid])));assert.ok(c.calls[0].params.includes(user.tenant_id));});
test('repository forbids overriding tenant on insert and identity on update',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user);await assert.rejects(()=>s.insert('u_emissions',{tenant_id:id()}),/Tenant invariant/);await assert.rejects(()=>s.update('u_emissions',id(),{created_by:id()}),/Identity/);assert.equal(c.calls.length,0);});
test('repository user reference queries never select password hashes',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user);await s.maybe('users',id());assert.ok(!c.calls[0].sql.includes('password_hash'));});
test('lexical search escapes wildcard characters and never interpolates user text',async()=>{const c=client(),s=new UniversityStore(c,user);await s.searchApproved("x%' OR true --");assert.ok(c.calls[0].params[1].includes('\\%'));assert.ok(!c.calls[0].sql.includes("x%'"));});
test('transaction snapshot sets isolation before its first query and keeps tenant local',async()=>{const c=client();await universityTx({connect:async()=>c},user,async()=>42,{snapshot:true});assert.equal(c.calls[0].sql,'BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ');assert.match(c.calls[1].sql,/set_config\('app.tenant_id',\$1,true\)/);assert.ok(c.calls.some(q=>q.sql==='COMMIT'));assert.equal(c.calls.at(-1).release,true);});
test('transaction failure rolls back and releases the connection',async()=>{const c=client();await assert.rejects(()=>universityTx({connect:async()=>c},user,async()=>{throw Error('sentinel');}),/sentinel/);assert.ok(c.calls.some(q=>q.sql==='ROLLBACK'));assert.ok(!c.calls.some(q=>q.sql==='COMMIT'));assert.equal(c.calls.at(-1).release,true);});
test('migration plan includes unchanged core plus additive university migration',async()=>{const plan=await migrationPlan();assert.deepEqual(plan.map(p=>p.version),[1,2,3,4,5]);assert.equal(plan[0].file,'001_core.sql');assert.match(plan[1].sql,/security_invoker=true/);});
test('university migration declares forced RLS, tenant composite references and immutable snapshots',async()=>{const sql=await readFile(new URL('../../migrations/002_university.sql',import.meta.url),'utf8');assert.match(sql,/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY/);assert.match(sql,/FOREIGN KEY\(tenant_id,campus_id,department_id\)/);assert.match(sql,/REVOKE UPDATE ON cs/);assert.match(sql,/snapshot_immutable/);assert.match(sql,/u_one_pending_revision/);});
```

```python
        portal.locator('#consent').check();portal.locator('#answers button').click();expect(portal.locator('#received')).to_contain_text('Response received');assert 'UI-TEST-ONLY' not in portal.url;done('capability portal invalid-token handling, consent and one response form')
        mobile_context=browser.new_context(viewport={'width':390,'height':844},is_mobile=True,device_scale_factor=1);mobile=mobile_context.new_page();mobile.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)));login(mobile)
        assert mobile.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth+1');mobile.screenshot(path=str(out/'dashboard-mobile.png'),full_page=True);done('390px mobile overview has no document-level horizontal overflow')
        mobile.locator('[data-view="tasks"]').click();mobile.get_by_role('button',name='+ Create collection task',exact=True).click();expect(mobile.locator('#operationDialog')).to_be_visible();assert mobile.evaluate('document.querySelector("#operationDialog").getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth+1');done('mobile request dialog stays within viewport')
        assert not errors,errors;done('no uncaught JavaScript exceptions')
        browser.close()
    result={'passed':len(checks),'checks':checks,'browser':'Chromium via Playwright','data':'SYNTHETIC_LOOPBACK_FIXTURE','mode':'DOM_WITH_LOCAL_HTTP_BRIDGE' if dom_harness else 'DIRECT_BROWSER_HTTP','browserNavigationTested':not dom_harness,'productionCSPTested':not dom_harness,'postgresqlTested':False,'objectStorageTested':False,'antivirusTested':False,'screenshots':['dashboard-desktop.png','dashboard-mobile.png']};(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
finally:
    p.terminate()
    try:p.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill()
```
